variants.text:
Generate an ultra-realistic, cinematic, high-speed action video while completely maintaining the reference image <<<Image1>>>.

A cinematic action scene where a male character speeds through skyscrapers using high-tension, spider-web-like material during the warm light of the golden hour. All movements must occur between buildings, very close to exterior walls and windows, and below or barely at the rooftop line. Do not remain in the open sky for long periods.

[Action Sequence (Important)]

The sequence begins with “forward acceleration.”
<<<Image1>>> fires a web towards a building in the forward-upward direction, and the tension pulls him forward instantly, speeding him straight through the gap between buildings. He proceeds while grazing the walls and windows, showing strong speed and depth.

Next, maintaining momentum, he executes a large jump, leaping across the gap between buildings in a single bound. He is briefly in the open space here but immediately transitions to the next action.

After the jump, the character momentarily loses balance and begins to fall. Depict a realistic fall, rapidly dropping due to gravity. This creates a momentary thrill.

While falling, <<<Image1>>> immediately fires a web towards the edge or structure of a building in the upward direction, hooking it mid-air. At that instant, the intense tension violently pulls his body upward, resulting in an explosive ascent.

He then fires a web forward again, returning to forward acceleration.

Limit the use of webs to 2–3 times in total, ensuring each action is clearly visible.

[Movement Characteristics]
All movements must adhere to realistic physics based on inertia, gravity, and tension. Deceleration or hovering is prohibited. The flow of speed must be continuous, creating a clear dynamic rhythm of “acceleration → leap → fall → explosive ascent → re-acceleration.”

[Physical Expression]
At the moment of firing the web, one arm is sharply thrust forward or upward. During acceleration, the body is stretched and elongated by the pull, with the legs trailing behind. During the jump, the whole body carries momentum, and during the fall, the body collapses naturally according to gravity. During the pull-up, the body is lifted upward in a dynamic motion.

[Camera]
The camera should primarily maintain a tracking shot in the direction of forward movement, following the character from behind or close-up. Constantly emphasize the movement into the depth, maximizing the sense of speed and perspective change. Do not use side angles.

[Direction]
Utilize reflections on glass curtain walls, flowing window lines, strong motion blur, clothing fluttering due to wind pressure, and lens flares to create an overwhelming sense of speed and immersion. The distance to the walls should always be close, emphasizing the thrill of near-collision.

[Emotion]
Express concentration, excitement, adrenaline, confidence, and the exhilaration derived from recovering from a momentary crisis (the fall).

A dust-covered man stands alone in a wasteland. Handheld camera circles him in a 360° orbit with slight shake from heat. He slowly raises his hand—fingertips turn semi-transparent, air distorts.
His body convulses under pressure. Glowing golden cracks spread beneath his skin, bones crack. Purple-black smoke with blue electrical arcs bursts from his spine. Deep fractures leak liquid gold.
Floating metal debris is pulled toward him. Rusted black armor plates slam into his body with sparks, forming uneven armor—cracked shoulders and a chest plate revealing a molten core.
Red metal spreads across his face, forming a mask. His eyes collapse, then ignite with blue electric light, one flickering. Two large black horns emerge with faint purple flames.
Final: he raises his hand, forming a blue flame like a miniature black hole. He slams the ground—spiraling gravity shockwave destroys nearby ruins. Silence. Broken black wings extend. He lifts his head, blue eyes glowing through the fog.

漂浮的金属碎片被吸向他。锈迹斑斑的黑色装甲板伴随着火花撞击在他的身体上，形成不规则的盔甲——破碎的肩甲和胸甲露出熔融的核心。
红色的金属覆盖了他的脸部，形成面具。他的双眼塌陷，随后燃起蓝色的电光，其中一只在闪烁。两只巨大的黑色犄角长出，伴随着微弱的紫色火焰。

2–4s
Door POV shot.

Hard cut to ultra-wide lens distortion as the cat steps out.
Transition: whip pan morph into street scene.

Street, night. Neon reflections on wet ground.
360° orbit shot: grey hyenas in black suits and sunglasses close in.
Camera speed ramps up, then abruptly STOPS → silence.

Bullet-time begins.

Camera rotates around frozen figures.
Only the cat moves in real time.

— The cat launches forward → camera follows with insane handheld shake

• macro impact shots (fabric compressing inward)
• fisheye lens kicks toward camera
• spinning POV from flying hyena
— Final move: slow-motion 360° spinning kick → ALL hyenas launched outward simultaneously
— Sound snaps back at impact → BOOM

12–15s
Silence. Dust settles mid-air.
Camera slowly pushes through floating debris (still partially in slow motion).
The cat lands in real time.
Looks directly into lens, slight head tilt, playful grin.

Line (sharp, confident):
“follow cat master for more fluffy chaos.”

Freeze frame → sudden glitch zoom → retro punch sound.

第 1 章（0-15 秒）：楼顶觉醒 · 奔跑与纵身跃下（由前至后的视角）风格：粗犷、原始的写实风格，采用 35mm 手持胶片摄影，带有自然的胶片颗粒感和轻微的晃动。重庆正午耀眼的直射阳光营造出高对比度的强烈阴影和光晕。摄像机：单次连续的第三人称手持跟拍（无剪辑），从低机位正面开始，平滑过渡到肩后/背部视角，全程跟随主角
Image 1
。氛围：高空强风呼啸，尘雾飞扬，布料、头发和机械部件呈现出逼真的物理漂浮效果。音效：沉浸式空间音效：机械高跟鞋敲击混凝土的金属回声、沉重且有节奏的呼吸声、呼啸的风声、机械关节运作的声音、衣物剧烈拍打声，跳跃瞬间的突然静止，随后是坠落时高速切风的尖啸声。[视觉参考/描述]：必须完全保留参考图中的优雅女性角色，身穿白色西装，佩戴银色机械胸甲和颈圈，拥有银色机械手和银色高跟长靴（黑色长直马尾辫，精致的面部特征，大耳环）。她的身体特征和服装细节（白色西装上的银色饰边、机械胸甲的露胸设计、背部机械脊椎细节、机械手套）必须完全一致。场景为重庆来福士广场摩天大楼楼顶，周围高楼林立，远处可见宽阔的长江。[每秒时间轴] 0-4 秒：[正面起始] 手持摄像机从低机位正面捕捉角色全身。她站在楼顶平台边缘，神情冷静而坚定地直视镜头。机械颈椎强烈反射着正午阳光，马尾辫在高空风中飘动。她缓慢转身。4-9 秒：[肩后跟拍 · 全力冲刺] 镜头切换至肩后视角，紧密跟随。她在混凝土平台上冲刺，机械高跟鞋每一步都迸发出金属火花。西装下摆和机械脊椎外骨骼在气流中剧烈摆动，楼顶尘土飞扬，布料物理效果极其逼真。9-12 秒：[纵身跃下] 她突然跃出。双脚离开地面的瞬间，镜头略微下沉并切换为快速向下追踪的视角。西装在极端气流中剧烈翻滚，来福士的玻璃幕墙在两侧迅速向上移动，运动模糊感强烈爆发。[风格与质量提升] 逼真的 8K 画质，超精细的机械纹理和布料物理效果，电影级布光与高对比度，完美的运动模糊，高动态范围，无伪影，连贯的多模态物理特效，电影级画面稳定性。

第 2 章（0-15 秒）：自由落体 · 紫色 AITO M7 入画 风格：粗犷写实风格，35mm 手持摄像机，自然胶片颗粒，轻微的有机晃动。摄像机：主要采用手持跟拍，允许快速剪辑（主角坠落视角 ↔ 地面汽车追逐视角交替）以营造极度紧张的节奏。全程保持实时高速节奏，无慢动作。布光：重庆正午耀眼的高对比度直射阳光，来福士玻璃幕墙上的强烈反射，路面散发出的热浪。音效：切风尖啸声持续增强 → 远处驶来汽车的引擎轰鸣声 → 轮胎摩擦沥青的尖锐声 → 赛博能量嗡鸣声 → 接触瞬间的金属撞击声 → 四轮着地的沉闷冲击声 → 引擎轰鸣声不减反增，进一步加速。[视觉参考/描述] 主角为参考图中的同一女性角色，保留所有细节。场景：来福士下方的重庆匝道，一辆紫色的华为 AITO M7（智界 R7）正在高速正常行驶。它利用上坡匝道自然起跳，凭借惯性精准接住从楼顶坠落的主角。全程无慢动作特写，保持写实的高速电影节奏。[每秒时间轴] 紧接
Video 1
，延长 15 秒。0-4 秒：[极速坠落 · 俯瞰地面] 主角
Image 1
 高速坠落，全程保持双臂展开的平衡滑翔姿态。镜头锁定她的背部。来福士幕墙在两侧迅速飞升，地面快速放大，运动模糊感极强。画面快速插入地面视角：一辆紫色华为 AITO M7 正在来福士下方的匝道上飞驰。车身散发着赛博蓝紫色能量光芒，引擎轰鸣，轮胎在沥青路面上留下两道黑印。4-9 秒：[匝道起跳 · 轨迹交汇] 紫色 AITO M7 冲向匝道顶部。利用匝道的惯性，车头腾空而起，天窗瞬间自动滑开。镜头在坠落的主角与起跳的 AITO M7 之间快速切换——主角保持双臂展开的高速坠落姿态，AITO M7 继续沿匝道加速。两条轨迹迅速汇合，将时间感压缩到极致，最大化紧张感。9-11 秒：[最后一秒 · 姿态调整 · 精准进入] 距离天窗仅剩一秒时——主角瞬间收紧展开的双臂，猛地将身体从水平滑翔姿态调整为垂直直立姿态。双腿笔直指向空中紫色 AITO M7 的开启天窗。动作迅速、果断，毫不犹豫。下一瞬间，她垂直坠入开启的天窗，身体以极高速度进入车内，落入驾驶座。全程无慢动作；冲击感真实而剧烈。11-13 秒：[四轮着地 · 保持行驶] 车身在接住主角冲击的瞬间略微压缩，四轮稳稳回到沥青路面。悬挂系统剧烈吸收了双重冲击。着地后引擎轰鸣声立即升级。未减速或停顿，四轮摩擦沥青留下新的黑色胎痕，继续全速向前行驶。13-15 秒：[车内稳定 · 能量积蓄] AITO M7 保持高速行驶。镜头从靠近侧面的低机位追踪车辆：车身上的蓝紫色能量纹路开始从四轮向车身蔓延。机械传动声从车底隐约升起并持续增强。高速行驶中车身轻微震动。即将变形的预兆能量在车漆下涌动翻腾。[风格与质量提升] 逼真的 8K 画质，超精细的机械与能量光效纹理，电影级体积光与热浪效果，完美的动态模糊，HDR 能量光晕，无伪影，全程实时速度无慢动作。

第 3 章（0-15 秒）：AITO M7 变形 · 变为 F-14 · 主角屹立机背起飞 风格：粗犷写实风格，35mm 手持胶片美学，自然颗粒，轻微晃动。摄像机：多角度剪辑跟拍（地面追踪 / 低机位贴地 / 飞机侧面 / 主角第一人称），全程紧跟飞行器。变形细节必须清晰可见。氛围：轻烟与热浪弥漫在重庆道路上。赛博蓝紫色光影在建筑间折射。正午阳光在金属结构上形成耀眼的反射和强烈的阴影。音效：引擎轰鸣声突然升级 → 金属蒙皮爆裂与折叠声 → 液压机翼展开的低沉震动 → 主角
Image 1
 在飞机外侧攀爬时的金属抓握声 → 驾驶舱密封爆裂“砰”的一声随即被风声淹没 → 双引擎点火的爆炸轰鸣 → F-14 起飞破空的尖啸声 → 高空强气流的呼啸声覆盖所有音轨。[视觉参考/描述] 紫色 AITO M7 在重庆道路行驶中完成完全变形，从汽车形态变为 F-14 战斗机
Image 2
。主角在变形过程中惊险地攀附并爬上飞行器外侧。最终主角站在 F-14 战斗机背部中央，双腿微张以稳定重心。她的白色西装和马尾辫在极端气流中剧烈飘动。F-14 直接从重庆道路上起飞，主角稳稳站在机背上。[每秒时间轴] 0-4 秒：[道路加速 · 变形开始] AITO M7 在重庆道路上迅速加速。车身面板依次爆开并展开。前引擎盖卷起并转化为机械结构。车门向两侧折叠。金属蒙皮沿结构线开裂，露出冰冷的机械内部结构。主角在剧烈的变形过程中惊险地向飞行器顶部攀爬，紧紧抓住变形中的金属骨架。她随着飞行器形状的改变而跳跃、移动位置。动作紧张刺激。镜头从飞机侧面近距离追踪每一个攀爬细节。4-6 秒：[机翼展开 · 引擎完全重组] F-14 标志性的后掠翼从折叠状态突然展开并锁定。镜头拍摄机翼展开的低机位、贴地全景。热浪和尘土被机翼气流剧烈扬起。双引擎短舱剧烈重组为喷气结构，喷出蓝紫色推进火焰。路面被尾焰灼烧。主角此时已爬至机背中央，双脚稳稳踩在飞行器结构上，随着变形完成，身体站得笔直。6-8 秒：[主角屹立机背 · 起飞] 变形完成的瞬间，主角在 F-14 战斗机背上完全站直。白色西装下摆在强气流中剧烈上扬，马尾辫水平飘动。银色机械部件强烈反射着正午阳光。F-14 双引擎全功率点火。飞行器突然加速，前轮离地，后轮在最后一刻蹬离沥青路面。机头昂起，载着背上的主角冲入重庆天空。8-15 秒：[起飞并掠过城市 · 主角稳立] F-14 垂直爬升后猛地压低机头，以极低高度掠过重庆。

prompt:
A hyper-realistic, 8K resolution, adrenaline-fueled single-take POV action sequence. The camera is chest-mounted on a man wearing camouflage joggers and worn-out black-and-white sneakers. He stands on the dizzying edge of a rusted skyscraper, 1000 feet above a crystalline turquoise ocean. No clouds, no haze—just a sheer, terrifying vertical drop into the deep blue.

[The Initial Freefall]
The sequence begins with a sudden, heart-stopping leap into a 20-meter vertical freefall. The camera points directly at his feet as the sea surface rushes toward the lens. A deafening, high-pitched whistling 'Hyuo' wind screams past the microphone. Just before the impact, he catches a lower rusted horizontal bar with both hands—white wristband visible—and swings his body forward to land on a tiny vertical pole.

[The Rhythmic Jumps & The Near-Death Slip]
He immediately begins a rhythmic series of high-speed jumps:

Jump 1: A clean, agile spring to a second vertical pole 2 meters away.

Jump 2: A rapid leap to a thin, rusted horizontal pipe.

Jump 3 (The Slip): As he jumps toward the third vertical pole, his right sneaker completely misses the mark and slides off the rusted metal. The camera tilts violently over the edge, staring straight down at the 1000-foot abyss. He lets out a sharp, panicked gasp. For a terrifying second, his body leans into the void, but he desperately claws at the pole with his fingers, his boots scrambling against the side until he manages to hook his leg and haul himself back up.

Jump 4: Still trembling, he forces a frantic, heavy-breathing leap to the next bar to keep the momentum.

Jump 5: A final, explosive long-distance jump to a swaying metal platform. He lands with a heavy, jarring metallic 'Clang', his body hunching low, gripping the vibrating metal for dear life.

[The Ending]
The camera remains in a low, fetal position on the final bar, shaking from the adrenaline. No dialogue. The audio is a visceral layer of the aggressive 'Hyuo' wind, his intense, ragged, and rapid gasping for air, and a loud, thumping heartbeat that resonates as if inside his chest. The harsh midday sun glints off the ocean waves far below, creating a blinding, beautiful, yet lethal glare. Cinematic materials, fluid 120fps motion, hyper-detailed rust and skin textures.

[初始自由落体]
序列以一次突如其来、令人心跳停止的 20 米垂直自由落体开始。当海面冲向镜头时，摄像机直指他的双脚。麦克风中传来震耳欲聋、尖锐的“Hyuo”风声。在即将撞击海面之前，他用双手抓住了下方一根生锈的横杆（可见白色腕带），并将身体向前摆动，落在一根细小的垂直杆上。

[节奏跳跃与惊险滑落]
他随即开始了一系列节奏感十足的高速跳跃：

跳跃 1：敏捷地跃向 2 米外第二根垂直杆。

跳跃 2：快速跃向一根细长的生锈横管。

跳跃 3（滑落）：当他跳向第三根垂直杆时，他的右脚运动鞋完全踩空，从生锈的金属上滑落。摄像机剧烈地向边缘倾斜，直视下方 1000 英尺的深渊。他发出一声尖锐、惊恐的喘息。在惊心动魄的一秒钟里，他的身体向虚空倾斜，但他绝望地用手指抠住杆子，靴子在侧面乱蹬，直到他设法勾住腿并将自己拉了回来。

跳跃 4：尽管身体仍在颤抖，他强迫自己进行了一次急促、沉重的跳跃，以保持惯性。

跳跃 5：最后一次爆发性的长距离跳跃，落向一个晃动的金属平台。他以一声沉重、刺耳的金属“哐当”声落地，身体蜷缩，死死抓住震动的金属。

[结尾]
摄像机保持在最后一个杆上的低位蜷缩姿势，因肾上腺素而颤抖。没有对话。音频是极具冲击力的“Hyuo”风声、他剧烈且急促的喘息声，以及仿佛在胸腔内共鸣的沉重心跳声。正午刺眼的阳光在远方的海浪上闪烁，营造出一种耀眼、美丽却致命的光芒。电影级材质，流畅的 120fps 运动，超细节的锈迹和皮肤纹理。

【场景环境】
一条向远方延伸的被毁城市街道。两侧是废弃的混凝土建筑，钢筋裸露，窗户破碎，部分建筑仍在燃烧，冒着橘色火焰和黑烟。开裂的沥青路面上散落着废弃车辆，其中几辆正在燃烧。天空阴沉灰暗，烟尘悬浮在空中。多颗陨石拖着长长的火尾和浓烟划过天际。背景中，惊恐的平民在废墟间四散奔逃，有人摔倒，有人拖着伤者。
【主角】
中国美女，深红色头发扎成凌乱的松散发髻，几缕发丝垂在脸侧。皮肤白皙，五官立体，下颌线清晰，自然妆容，眼妆精致。着装：黑色长款皮风衣内搭黑色背心，黑色牛仔短裙，黑色平底战靴，无腰带，双手佩戴黑色未来感护手。表情紧张而克制，带着一丝痛苦，眉头微蹙——眼神中充满绝望与坚定的意志。
【15 秒一镜到底 · 觉醒冲击版】
0-2 秒 · 觉醒
低角度镜头，取景上半身及面部，仰视她独自站在被毁街道中央。风吹动她的黑色皮风衣。她张开嘴用日语喊道：“Kakusei shiro!”（觉醒吧！）。她突然张开右手，黑色未来感护手发出噼啪声。紫色晶体质感的电弧从手臂和护手处迸发。空气向内压缩，空间扭曲变形。冲击波发出低沉的音爆声。紫色符文线条在她身体周围浮现并环绕。
2-5 秒 · 爆发
镜头开始环绕她旋转。暗金色的裂纹从她胸口炸开，浓稠的金色液体像血液一样渗出。她痛苦地尖叫。紫色雾气和细小电弧向外喷射。她所有的衣物从内部撕裂并爆炸，烧成灰烬——不留一丝痕迹。有机装甲碎片向外喷射，随后以不自然的方式回缩并重新附着在身体上。紫色纹路对称地蔓延到她脸上。脸颊裂开一道缝隙，露出下方搏动着的紫色光芒。与此同时，多个机械臂状的附属物从她背部猛烈弹出——深金属质感，刀刃状，像恶魔之翼一样向外张开。火花、蓝色电弧和金色能量粒子从爆发点炸开。镜头从背后捕捉完整的展开过程——她的剪影映衬在灰暗的天空中，机械附属物像扇子一样展开。爆发声如同撕裂金属混合着电弧放电的声音。
5-8 秒 · 生长
有机物质从她身体渗出，表面闪烁着虹彩光芒。白色装甲板碰撞并融合，留下灼烧痕迹。装甲向下延伸，完全覆盖并取代了她的平底战靴，形成白色与深紫色交织的装甲靴，伴随着细小的火花锁定到位。她咬紧牙关，发出痛苦的咆哮。胸前的核心像余烬一样闪烁。紫黑色金属蔓延至面部，形成不规则的面具，左眼先被覆盖，随后是右眼。复眼开始形成，不规则地闪烁着液态光介质。镜头继续环绕她旋转。
8-12 秒 · 完成

Camera Simulation
Shot on 65mm IMAX film with a vintage anamorphic lens. Noticeable film grain, subtle gate weave, and soft halation on highlights. Occasional lens breathing subtly warps the image as the body mutates.

Lighting Style
A dead, fog-covered wasteland under a massive dim moon.
Moonlight is unnaturally cold, casting blue-gray tones across the entire scene.
As the transformation begins, a deep amber-gold light burns from inside his body, clashing with the cold lunar light.

Dual-tone lighting:
Outside: cold lunar blue
Inside: feral burning orange

Scene Description
A man (use the uploaded face as reference, preserve exact facial identity and features) stands alone in a misty, desolate landscape. The camera moves in a handheld, slow circular orbit around him. Wind howls softly through the fog.

He looks up at the moon—his expression tired, resisting something within. His breathing becomes heavier. His fingers twitch unnaturally.

His body suddenly begins to break—his spine jerks, bones shift visibly beneath the skin in a disturbing, organic motion. A low growl escapes his throat, not fully human. Veins darken, then pulse with a dim amber glow from within.

His fingernails crack and extend into rough, uneven claws.

The transformation intensifies violently. His jaw stretches forward painfully, not snapping instantly but distorting in a slow, agonizing motion. Teeth push through his gums. Thick fur erupts unevenly across his body—messy, dirty, mixed with sweat and blood.

His posture collapses forward into a half-beast stance. The camera shakes more aggressively, reacting to the energy and movement.

He is caught in a disturbing hybrid state—not fully human, not fully beast:
One arm fully wolf-like, the other still human but breaking apart.
His face is asymmetrical—one eye human, the other glowing with feral light.

Nearby metal debris subtly vibrates—not magnetically, but reacting to a primal energy frequency emanating from him. His chest glows faintly, as if something inside is trying to break out.

Then—final snap.

His body fully transforms into a towering werewolf:
Massive, muscular frame
Wet, matted fur
Heavy breath steaming in the cold air
Eyes reflecting cold moonlight mixed with inner fire

His silhouette stands against the moon.

Silence.

He slowly lowers his head—not in rage, but pure instinct. The camera holds close on his face. A subtle twitch.

Then suddenly—he bursts forward at extreme speed, vanishing into the fog.

摄影模拟

场景描述
一名男子（请使用上传的面部作为参考，保留精确的面部身份和特征）独自站在雾气弥漫的荒凉景观中。摄像机以手持方式围绕他进行缓慢的环形运动。风在雾中轻声呼啸。

他抬头望向月亮——表情疲惫，似乎在抗拒体内的某种力量。他的呼吸变得沉重，手指不自然地抽动。

他的身体突然开始崩裂——脊椎猛地抽动，骨骼在皮肤下以一种令人不安的有机方式明显位移。他的喉咙里发出低沉的咆哮，不再完全属于人类。静脉变暗，随后脉动着体内透出的微弱琥珀色光芒。

他的指甲开裂并延伸成粗糙、不规则的利爪。

变身过程剧烈加剧。他的下颚痛苦地向前拉伸，并非瞬间折断，而是以一种缓慢、痛苦的方式扭曲。牙齿从牙龈中挤出。浓密的毛发在他身上不均匀地长出——凌乱、肮脏，混合着汗水和血液。

他的姿态向前坍塌，呈现出半兽人的站姿。摄像机晃动得更加剧烈，以响应能量和动作的变化。

他陷入了一种令人不安的混合状态——既非完全的人类，也非完全的野兽：
一只手臂完全狼化，另一只手臂仍保持人类形态但正在崩裂。
他的面部呈现不对称状——一只眼睛是人类的，另一只闪烁着野性的光芒。

附近的金属碎片在微微震动——并非受磁力影响，而是对从他体内散发出的原始能量频率产生了反应。他的胸口发出微弱的光芒，仿佛有什么东西正试图破体而出。

魁梧、肌肉发达的身躯
湿润、纠结的毛发
沉重的呼吸在冷空气中化作蒸汽
双眼反射着冷冽的月光与内心的火焰

他的剪影矗立在月光之下。

寂静。

他缓缓低下头——并非出于愤怒，而是纯粹的本能。摄像机近距离聚焦在他的脸上。一次细微的抽动。

[0-3s] A real weathered red torii gate at night. Camera starts ground-level at the base of the gate looking up — then rapidly orbits 180 degrees around the torii post, accelerating as it swings, revealing the misty stone steps and orange lantern glow on the other side. The movement is fast and sweeping.

[3-6s] A narrow Kyoto backstreet at night. Camera bursts forward at high speed down the alley in a fast dolly rush — wooden machiya houses and red lanterns blur past on both sides. A woman in a dark kimono steps aside. Camera tilts sharply upward mid-rush to reveal the sky framed between the rooftops, then snaps back down.

[6-9s] Shibuya scramble crossing at night. Camera starts low in the crowd, spins 360 degrees fast at hip level — people and neon signs streak past — then rapidly cranes straight up into the air, rising fast to reveal the full intersection below. The spin-to-rise transition is sudden and energetic.

[9-12s] A shinkansen N700 bullet train. Camera holds static for a split second — then the train BLASTS past at full speed inches from the lens, the shockwave shaking the frame violently. Camera immediately whips to track it from behind, accelerating to match speed, rice fields streaking.

[12-15s] Wide aerial Tokyo at dusk. Camera starts in tight on city streets, then rockets upward fast — buildings shrinking rapidly — spinning slightly as it rises, until the full Tokyo bay and Mount Fuji horizon are revealed. Camera decelerates and holds the grand final frame steady. Audio style: High-energy EDM, hard synth drops, 140BPM, bass hit on each camera snap. No text, subtitles, watermarks, or logos. prompt: The wind threads through the black pines like a dull blade scraping bone. Snow doesn’t fall—it lashes sideways, stinging into the gaps of a collar, melting into a sharp, immediate pain. The torchlight trembles in the white storm, revealing a trunk, a branch, a sliver of ground—then surrendering it back to the deeper dark. They move slowly. Boots sink with a muffled crunch, and every step feels like an argument with the forest: please don’t notice us. Someone coughs once and regrets it instantly—the sound rebounds, thin and humiliating, as if the trees are laughing at his fear. The mail should be warm by now, tempered by body heat, but it isn’t. prompt:
Dark navy background. A few small objects drift along a wide circular orbit — the rotation center sits in the upper right of the frame, the camera watches from the outer edge. A decorated box, a striped ball, and a couple of carnival items arc past one by one, curving leftward across the view. Sparse confetti strips and gold coins float through the air.

Three cream-colored rectangular talismans appear on the same orbital path, each bearing a different painted emblem. They approach one at a time, sweeping across the camera in a wide arc.

A glowing golden-framed card carrying a character illustration enters along the orbit. It drifts to center screen and the camera pushes in. The golden frame swells beyond the screen edges and vanishes — only the character remains. Gold sparkles and cross-shaped flares surround the reveal.

Red talismans orbit the character in irregular circular paths. Flame-colored ribbons weave through the hair. A fireball ignites near the outstretched hand, swelling until it fills nearly half the screen with white-hot light. The fireball contracts back toward the hands. Energy converts — flames dissolve into crackling purple arcs. The talismans transform into large glowing red rectangles covered in flame-crest patterns, fanning out in formation.

The character spins with the talismans fanning wider. Camera drives in — golden light ignites in both eyes, a held beat of charge. Pull back to full body. White-gold explosion erupts outward. The talismans launch toward the camera — one large talisman surges forward, dark surface swirling with magenta crests, growing until it covers the entire frame. Black.

New scene. No character visible. Red glowing rectangles streak across dark space in a wide circular arc, trailing fire. They converge on a single point at center screen. On impact, red flash fills the screen — hot pink wash expands, then fades.

Red-orange glowing core at the center with spiral energy arcs rotating around it. More red rectangles converge from all sides onto the central energy sphere. Everything compresses to a single bright point — total whiteout.

Fireball detonates outward with radial god rays. It expands to half the screen, then disperses. Red rectangle debris drifts through the flames. The color shifts — red bleeds to magenta, magenta to purple. In one frame, cold blue-purple replaces everything. New scene.

prompt:
キャラクターリファレンスとして @Image1 を使用してください。キャラクターデザイン、髪型、耳、尻尾、衣装、色を完全に一貫させてください。

【被写体】

長く流れるような青い髪、大きくふわふわした狐の耳、そして巨大でふわふわした尻尾を持つ狐耳の少女。
巫女をイメージした衣装を着用し、袖はゆったりとしており、スカートは短め。
日本の神社を背景に立ち、赤い鳥居があり、周囲には紅葉が舞っている。
表情は遊び心があり、エネルギッシュで、少しからかうような雰囲気。

【アクション】

頻繁なジャンプ動作を伴う、エネルギッシュで弾むようなダンスを披露する。

リズムに合わせて繰り返される軽いジャンプ（ぴょんぴょん）
自然な動きのために、各ジャンプの前に膝を深く曲げる
髪、袖、尻尾が物理演算に従ってダイナミックに弾む
尻尾は誇張された追従動作で揺れる
ジャンプ中に一度スピン（360°のクイックスピン）
着地は柔らかく、すぐに次のジャンプへ移行する
腕を大きく振り、勢いをつけるために内側に引き寄せる
最後はハイジャンプで締めくくり、着地時に遊び心のあるポーズをとる

👉 重要な安定化の指示

明確な膝の屈伸と着地時の加重制御
自然な重力と滑らかなジャンプの弧
空中での身体の歪みはなし
尻尾は遅延を伴う二次的な動きに従う
【カメラ】
ランドスケープ 16:9、15 秒
開始：全身のワイドショット（ジャンプを確認するために全身を表示）
ジャンプの高さを強調するわずかなローアングル
垂直方向の動きを追う緩やかなトラッキング
ジャンプに同期した、手持ちカメラのようなわずかな揺れ
スピンジャンプ中のミッドセクションズーム
終了：最後のポーズに着地する際のわずかなプッシュイン
【スタイル】
高品質な 2D アニメーション
滑らかで高いフレーム一貫性
明るい秋のカラーパレット（赤、オレンジ、金の紅葉）
木漏れ日のような柔らかな日光
布の物理演算と尻尾のボリューム感を強調した動き
クリーンな線画、少し柔らかい陰影
ライトブルームと被写界深度
【サウンド】

アップテンポで超エネルギッシュな J-POP / エレクトロダンス・トラック（約 170 BPM）

弾むようなベースとパンチの効いたキックドラム
明るいシンセメロディ
ジャンプに合わせたクラップとスネアのアクセント
キュートでエネルギッシュな女性ボーカル（短いフレーズ / 掛け声）
狐のような遊び心のある「ヘイ！」や「ヨッ！」というボーカルアクセント
神社らしい微かな環境音（風 + 落ち葉）

Everything blown violently upward: hair, jacket, trouser legs, shirt — continuous strong upward wind throughout. The visual grammar of terminal velocity. Camera whips around him — bug's eye from directly below looking up at him shrinking then rushing toward camera, overhead looking straight down at him, 10mm close pass inches from his face with the wind tearing at his hair and glasses, Dutch angle tracking his full body as he reaches. The bottle tumbles just past his fingers — he repositions fast, body rotating in the fall, reaching again. His glasses nearly torn off by the wind, he pushes them back with one hand without stopping reaching with the other. The fall feels violent and fast — not peaceful zero gravity, not serene floating. The roaring wind is constant and loud. His clothes are being destroyed by the air resistance — shirt billowing completely open, trouser legs flattened against his legs then snapping outward.
He finally grabs the bottle in one hard grip — fingers closing around the neck. He pulls it against the wind to his lips. Takes a long defiant sip. Wind still roaring. Hair still destroyed. 【コアコンセプト：究極のトロピカル・エスケープ】

1. シーン構成とアクション (Scene & Action)
オープニング：

視点は、茶髪の可愛らしい 20 歳の日本人女性の後ろを追う三人称のトラッキングショット。
トロピカルスタイルのクロップトップ・キャミソールにタイトなデニムのホットパンツという洗練されたリゾートスタイルで、ピンクの Rimowa 風アルミ製キャリーバッグを軽やかに引いている。肌は軽く日焼けしている。
場所はエメラルドグリーンの海に浮かぶ木製の桟橋（ウッドデッキ）。
抑えきれない興奮から、開始早々かなりの勢いで前方に走り出す。
歩幅は大きく、足取りは非常に軽やかで、キャリーバッグの車輪も彼女のスピードに合わせてスムーズに滑る。
髪とトップスの裾が風になびき、到着を待ちきれない高揚感を表現する。

ミドル（ルームツアー）：

モダンな水上ヴィラの木製ドアを開けると、広大なオーシャンビューが広がる。
カメラは彼女の動きと同期し、リビングルーム、円形の廊下、バスルームを素早くシームレスに移動する。
部屋に入ってからも彼女はほとんど減速せず、弾むような足取りで駆け抜ける。
目的地へ一直線に引き寄せられるかのような、期待に満ちた動き。
部屋の途中で、彼女は走りながら自然かつ素早くキャリーバッグのハンドルから手を離し、バッグは慣性で壁の方へ滑っていき静かに止まる。彼女は一切迷うことなく、テラスに向かってさらに加速する。

クライマックス：

彼女はヴィラのテラスから飛び出し、ほとんど減速せずに階段を駆け下り、迷うことなくターコイズブルーの海へダイブする。
この瞬間、彼女はすでに手ぶらで、飛び込むと同時に両腕を大きく広げる。
走る勢いがそのまま空中に伝わる、大胆で開放的なジャンプ。
空中で手足を大きく広げた瞬間と、美しく舞い上がる水しぶき（スプラッシュ）を捉える。

2. ビジュアルと技術的詳細 (Visual & Technical Details)
カメラワーク：
ハイパーダイナミック・フォローショット：ジンバルを使用したような揺れの少ない安定した距離感を保ちつつ、圧倒的なスピード感のあるトラッキングショット。
ワンカット風：まるでワンテイクで撮影されたかのようなシームレスなトランジション。
カメラは彼女の走るスピードを正確に追い、スピード感、没入感、爽快感を最大化する。
キャリーバッグから手を離す瞬間をスムーズにつなぎ、アクションの連続性が途切れない自然な流れを重視する。
ライティングとカラー：
透明感のあるトロピカルな日光：雲ひとつない完璧な晴天。真上から降り注ぐ太陽光が、海面をダイヤモンドのように輝かせる。
カラーパレット：
海は「シアン」「ターコイズ」「コバルトブルー」のグラデーション
空は「スカイブルー」
ヴィラは「ナチュラルウッド」と「ホワイト」
衣装は「ピュアホワイト」
髪色は「ライトブラウン」
これらを高彩度に設定し、視覚的な満足感を最大化する。
テクスチャとクオリティ：
水：底の砂紋が見えるほど極めて透明度が高い。飛び込んだ際の水しぶきは細部まで描写され、一滴一滴がクリスタルのように輝く。
建築：ヴィラの外壁は白い縦格子を用いたモダンなデザイン。ウッドデッキの床には、太陽に乾かされた木の質感が伝わるディテールを施す。
ワードローブと髪：トロピカルな風に強く自然になびく茶髪、そして白いクロップトップ・キャミソールとホットパンツが、開放感と健康的なサマースタイルを強調する。

variants.text:
【核心概念：终极热带度假】

1. 场景构图与动作 (Scene & Action)
开场：

视角为第三人称跟拍，跟随一位留着棕色头发、可爱的 20 岁日本女性。
她身着精致的度假风穿搭，包括热带风情的短款吊带背心和紧身牛仔热裤，轻快地拉着一个粉色 Rimowa 风格的铝制登机箱。皮肤略带小麦色。
地点位于漂浮在翡翠色海面上的木质栈道（木甲板）上。
她难掩兴奋之情，从一开始就带着十足的动力向前奔跑。
她的步伐很大，脚步非常轻盈，登机箱的轮子顺滑地滑动以配合她的速度。
她的头发和上衣下摆在风中飘动，传达出迫不及待想要抵达目的地的心情。

中段（房间巡游）：

当她推开现代水上别墅的木门时，广阔的海景映入眼帘。
摄像机与她的动作同步，快速且无缝地穿过客厅、环形走廊和浴室。
即使进入房间后，她几乎没有减速，依然迈着轻快的步伐奔跑。
动作中充满期待，仿佛被直接吸引向目的地。
在穿过房间的过程中，她自然而迅速地在奔跑中松开了登机箱的拉杆，箱子因惯性滑向墙边并静静停下。她毫不犹豫，继续向露台加速。

高潮：

她从别墅露台一跃而出，几乎不减速地跑下楼梯，毫不犹豫地跳入绿松石色的海中。
此时她已空手，跳跃时双臂张开。
这是一个大胆且舒展的跳跃，奔跑的动能直接转化为腾空的姿态。
捕捉她在空中四肢舒展的瞬间，以及水花（splash）优美飞溅的画面。

2. 视觉与技术细节 (Visual & Technical Details)
运镜：
超动态跟拍：一种与主体保持恒定距离的跟拍，几乎没有抖动，如同使用稳定器一般，但具有压倒性的速度感。
一镜到底风格：无缝转场，仿佛一次拍摄完成。
摄像机精准跟随她的奔跑速度，最大化速度感、沉浸感和爽快感。
强调自然的流动性，平滑连接她松开登机箱的瞬间，确保动作的连续性不被破坏。
光影与色彩：
清澈的热带日光：天气完美晴朗，万里无云。阳光从正上方倾泻而下，海面如同闪烁的钻石般反射光芒。
色彩基调：
海面呈现“青色”、“绿松石色”和“钴蓝色”的渐变
天空为“天蓝色”
别墅为“原木色”和“白色”
服装为“纯白色”
发色为“浅棕色”
这些色彩设定为高饱和度，最大化视觉满足感。
质感与质量：
水：水质极度透明，清澈到可以看到海底的沙纹。她跳入时的水花刻画细腻，每一滴水珠都如同水晶般晶莹剔透。
建筑：别墅外墙采用现代设计，带有白色垂直格栅。木甲板地板的细节传达出被阳光晒干的木材纹理。
服装与发型：她的棕色头发在热带海风中自然且剧烈地飘动，白色的短款吊带背心和热裤强调了开放感和健康的夏季风格。

[Core Concept: Ultimate Tropical Escape]

1. Scene Composition and Action (Scene & Action)
Opening:

The viewpoint is a third-person tracking shot following a cute 20-year-old Japanese woman with brown hair from behind.
She is wearing a sophisticated resort style consisting of a tropical-style crop-top camisole and tight denim hot pants, lightly pulling a pink Rimowa-style aluminum carry-on bag. She has slightly tanned skin.
The location is a wooden pier (wood deck) floating over an emerald green sea.
She starts running forward with considerable momentum right from the start, unable to contain her excitement.
Her strides are large, her footwork is very light, and the wheels of the carry-on bag glide smoothly in sync with her speed.
Her hair and the hem of her top flutter in the wind, conveying the exhilaration of being unable to wait for her arrival.

Middle Section (Room Tour):

When she opens the wooden door of the modern overwater villa, a vast ocean view spreads out before her.
The camera synchronizes with her movement, moving quickly and seamlessly through the living room, circular hallway, and bathroom without interruption.
She maintains almost full speed even after entering the room, running with a bouncy gait.
Her movement is filled with anticipation, as if she is being drawn straight to her destination.
Halfway through the room, she naturally and swiftly releases the handle of the carry-on bag while running, and the bag slides along the wall due to inertia and stops quietly. She doesn't hesitate at all and accelerates further toward the terrace.

Climax:

She leaps out from the villa's terrace, runs down the stairs with almost no deceleration, and dives into the turquoise blue sea without hesitation.
At this moment, her hands are free, and she jumps with her arms spread wide.
A bold, expansive jump where the momentum of her run carries her into the air.
The moment she spreads her limbs wide in the air, capturing the beautiful splash of water.

2. Visual and Technical Details (Visual & Technical Details)
Camera Work:
Hyper-dynamic follow shot: A tracking shot that maintains a constant distance from the subject, with minimal shaking, as if using a gimbal, yet conveying overwhelming speed.
One-cut style: Seamless transitions, as if filmed in a single continuous shot.
The camera precisely follows her running speed, maximizing the sense of speed, immersion, and exhilaration.
Emphasis is placed on a natural flow that ensures the continuity of action is not broken, even at the moment she releases the carry-on bag.
Lighting and Color:
Crystal clear tropical daylight: A cloudless, clear sky. Sunlight pours down from directly above, and the sea surface reflects like sparkling diamonds.
Color Palette:
Gradations of "Cyan," "Turquoise," and "Cobalt Blue" in the sea.
"Sky Blue" in the sky.
"Natural Wood" and "White" in the villa.
"Pure White" in her outfit.
"Light Brown" in her hair color.
These are set with high saturation to maximize visual satisfaction.
Texture and Quality:
Water: The water is extremely transparent, clear enough to see the sand ripples at the bottom. The splash when she dives is depicted with fine detail, each droplet like crystal.
Architecture: The exterior walls of the villa have a modern design with white vertical lattices. The wooden deck floor conveys the texture of wood dried by the sun.
Wardrobe & Hair: Her brown hair naturally flutters strongly in the tropical breeze, and the white crop-top camisole and hot pants emphasize a sense of openness and healthy summer style.

prompt:
视觉风格：中式动漫 3D CG，IMAX 电影级画质。
氛围基调：暴力美学对比，魔性、邪恶、优雅与残忍并存。
配色方案：以深青色、暗金色、琥珀色和翡翠绿为主，高对比度，空间纵深感强。
角色设定：年轻女教主。面容精致冷艳，五官凌厉，深绿色长发高高束起。身着深青色战裙式长袍，浮动着暗金色水纹。
核心道具：悬浮的九龙紫砂神鼎（古老深紫色，暗金色纹路流转，内含超高温灵茶）。
通用音效：贯穿始终的低沉风压声、远方军阵的咆哮声、甲胄摩擦声以及战旗猎猎作响声。

0-3 秒
镜头类型：宏观特写 -> 超微距追踪镜头 -> 极速主观俯冲。

视觉内容：
镜头锁定主角的右眼。她深邃的茶色眼眸中带有暗金色条纹，清晰倒映出城外 10 万大军与战场火光。眼神中充满戏谑与不屑。
镜头微移，她嘴角上扬，露出一抹淡淡的冷笑。
单手托举的九龙紫砂神鼎悬浮于空中。鼎口内的灵茶沸腾，热浪扭曲空气。
她伸出两根纤细的手指，以极其优雅而诡异的动作，从翻滚的热气中悠然拈起一片翠绿的嫩茶叶。
镜头贴近茶叶。当嫩叶离开她指尖的瞬间，时间仿佛静止。
茶叶开始高速旋转，锋利的边缘切割空气，周围产生细微的音爆与火花。
镜头切换至茶叶的主观视角（或紧随茶叶），从高空向下方战场中心极速俯冲，产生强烈的失重感。

音效增强：鼎内沸水的咆哮声、蒸汽的低吼声、茶叶破空及空气被剧烈撕裂的尖锐声。

3-6 秒
镜头类型：极速下坠 -> 超广角全景 -> 高空俯拍。

视觉内容：
镜头跟随茶叶剧烈下坠，在触地的瞬间，镜头猛然拉开至超广角全景。
轻盈的茶叶落地。
视觉奇观生成：以落点为中心，地面瞬间液化。泥土、战车、铁甲、旗帜全部被高温琥珀色灵茶吞噬。
古战场瞬间化作一片无边无际、翻滚沸腾的茶海。
高温茶浪疯狂蔓延，裹挟着毁灭性能量。敌军成片坠入茶海。铁甲迅速变红、软化、熔化，大量白汽冲天而起，遮天蔽日。
镜头升至俯拍视角。在压城的乌云下，整个战场已变成一锅沸腾的炼狱茶汤。温润的琥珀色下掩藏着极致的残忍。

音效增强：地面瞬间液化的闷响、茶海沸腾声、甲胄熔化的嘶鸣声，以及敌军惨叫声与蒸汽爆发声的混合。

6-10 秒
镜头类型：低空扫掠 -> 极速推镜头（正面） -> 跟随升降 -> 风暴穿梭 -> 俯冲回切。

视觉内容：
镜头低空扫掠，贴着沸腾的茶海表面滑行。茶液向两侧翻卷，蒸汽冲向镜头。
镜头极速推向主角正面。她立于高处，一尘不染，深绿色长发与深青色战袍在屠杀带来的热风中狂舞。
她的眼神陡然收紧，杀意如实质般穿透而出。
她指尖轻动。半空中的那片茶叶无声裂开，随即迅速发生疯狂裂变。
数量激增：数以亿计的翠绿锋利茶叶迸发，遮天蔽日。
镜头随叶群猛然升起。无数茶叶交织，汇聚成几道连接天地的绿色龙卷风暴，贯穿茶海、军阵与乌云。
风暴卷起无数敌军与战马，在密集的叶刃下被反复切割、碾碎、粉碎。
最终，所有人与物化作金绿色的荧光茶尘。
镜头先在风暴内部穿梭，展现极致的切割细节，随后跟随最猛烈的一道龙卷俯冲回战场。场面华丽、诡异、干净且果断。

音效增强：无数茶叶高速切割的嘶嘶声（类似高压水枪）、风暴的呼啸声、兵器集体断裂声以及血肉骨骼被粉碎的声音。

10-15 秒
镜头类型：仰拍大远景 -> 缓慢下压 -> 面部特写定格。

视觉内容：
风暴戛然而止，毫无征兆。
世界瞬间归于寂静。
镜头从仰拍大远景缓慢下压。天空中乌云撕裂，透出冷光。
茶海与 10 万大军一同消散。地面化作无边无际的镜面平原，倒映着主角孤寂的身影。
无数金绿色荧光茶尘像鬼火般在静谧的空气中缓慢漂浮。
主角的神情恢复懒散。她随手收起九龙紫砂神鼎，虚空中浮现出一张古朴茶桌与一杯清茶。
她端起茶杯，低头看向茶面。涟漪荡漾的茶汤中隐约倒映出刚才 10 万大军被屠戮的血腥场面。

prompt: 角色主体：一位年轻的女战士，留着多股编织的黑色长发，发丝在风中如墨色旗帜般飞舞。她面容清冷苍白，眼窝深邃，双唇紧抿，眼神如刀锋般锐利。她身穿全黑金属铠甲，表面流转着微弱的星光，仿佛将银河碎片锻造成了钢铁。左肩披着深蓝与黑色交织的星空斗篷，散落着无数细小的金色尘埃。她手持一把与身高齐平的黑铁巨剑；剑身宽大厚重，剑柄末端装饰着复杂的哥特式花纹，剑刃闪烁着淡淡的暗紫色电弧。环境场景：东方水墨风格的原始世界。一只远古神龟从浩瀚海面缓缓升起，背上驮着一座完整的东方古城——飞檐宫殿、密集的阁楼长廊、倾斜的塔楼以及层层叠叠的瓦房，一直延伸到龟背的最高处。巨龟的四肢如同插入海中的石柱，海水在四肢间如瀑布般倾泻而下。海面弥漫着浓雾，铅灰色的云层压得很低，云隙间偶尔有静默的闪电跳动。龟背古城的最高点是一处孤悬于云端的悬崖边缘，垂直的岩壁上布满了被海风侵蚀了千年的古老雕刻。色彩与光影：整体为水墨蓝灰色调，深蓝与靛青色的海面，白色的雾气透视。铠甲上的星光点提供微弱的暖金色散射光。闪电为冷白色，照亮时将角色的剪影投射在云墙上。在悬崖顶部的最后时刻，一道光束穿透乌云，如神谕般将苍白的阳光倾泻在角色身上。风格：真人电影质感，连续的物理摄像机运动，自然的镜头惯性与呼吸感，写实的空气透视，水墨美学与暗黑奇幻的融合，无 CG 感，带有胶片颗粒感和细微的镜头畸变。时间轴：0:00–0:03 镜头从海面下方开始，深蓝色的黑暗中，巨龟的腿像古老的柱子一样矗立在浑浊的水中。镜头沿龟腿表面上升，掠过苔藓、藤壶和千年石刻。微小的光尘在水中漂浮。当镜头破水而出时，水滴从镜头上滑落。世界从静谧的深蓝色转变为呼啸的灰白色迷雾。0:03–0:06 镜头继续攀升，随着惯性摇晃。龟背上的古城显露出来——底层是渔村废墟和锈迹斑斑的铁链桥；中层是密集的房屋和狭窄的石巷，部分窗户中闪烁着火光。一座高塔上悬挂着巨大的蛇形锁链，上面刻着类似梵文的封印符号，在风中发出呜咽声。镜头穿过两座倾斜塔楼之间的缝隙，碎石随之坠落。0:06–0:09 镜头绕行至城市侧面。一只灰白色的巨鹰从雾中滑出，双翼遮蔽了半个画面。气流带来的震动使镜头晃动。镜头跟随巨鹰向上飞行，揭示了悬崖的全貌——垂直的岩壁直冲云霄，刻满了巨大的古神浮雕，面部风化模糊，只剩下空洞的眼眶。一条狭窄的石阶蜿蜒而上；女战士出现在半山腰，正在攀爬。她的星空斗篷剧烈翻动，背上的巨剑在雾中留下一道紫色的电弧残影。0:09–0:12 切换至悬崖边缘，低角度。先是战士的手出现，金属护手抠进岩石裂缝，随后她翻身跃上顶端。落地时碎石四溅。她的黑发如墨色火焰般升起。她短暂跪地，喘息着，铠甲上的星光随心跳律动。她站起身，面对虚空——远处的迷雾中出现了更多巨龟的轮廓，组成了一支静默的远古舰队。深渊涌出的狂风撕扯着她的斗篷和发辫。0:12–0:15 她迈出最后一步来到边缘。她拔出巨剑；金属摩擦背甲发出刺耳声。她双手将剑高高举起。铅灰色的云层裂开，一道苍白的光刃精准地刺向她和剑身。剑刃上的暗紫色电弧在光线下爆发，迸发出火花与星尘，如同银河在边缘重新凝聚。她的剪影投射在身后翻滚的云层上。远处的巨龟舰队发出低沉的共鸣，海面震动，浓雾被推向四周形成同心圆。镜头拉远至全景——孤寂的悬崖之巅，一人一剑，伫立在背负千年古城的原始巨兽之上，身后是浩瀚迷雾与静默的巨龟舰队，光如柱，万物俯首。

path: prompts/真人/现实向/生活与vlog/youmind-3182--第一人称视角-杭州用餐恶作剧.md
prompt:
realistic live-action, single continuous shot, full first-person POV, no cuts, no angle changes, no scene transitions, no montage, no flash cuts, no music, no subtitles. Only two characters: my unseen first-person POV and @ Image1 sitting across from me. Natural ambient sound only: light restaurant noise, tableware, distant water, faint voices, chewing, spitting, rinsing, my laughter.

Setting:
Outdoor dining table beside West Lake, Hangzhou, near the water, calm daylight or soft late afternoon light. Real smartphone-video realism, grounded textures, realistic food, realistic body and hand motion, accurate chopstick use, accurate mouth movement, accurate eye focus. The lake stays visible to one side of frame.

Character:
@ Image1 is the only visible person. She can switch seamlessly between slightly fierce-cute and soft adorable. Lip sync, voice, expressions, and body language stay fully synchronized. Emotional arc: cheerful and relaxed while eating, then shocked disgust, then angry embarrassment.

Table:
Exactly 7 dishes on the table. One dish is the West Lake vinegar fish shown in @ Image2. @ Image1 is happily eating rice and the other dishes, but not the fish at first. The table feels full but readable. The fish dish remains clearly visible before I offer it to her.

Camera:
Entire video is from my seated first-person view across the table. My hand and chopsticks may enter frame naturally. Slight handheld micro-shake from breathing and laughter only, never chaotic. No third-person shots, no reverse shots, no overhead shots, no cutaways. Continuous believable framing centered on @ Image1 with part of the lake visible.

Action:
@ Image1 sits opposite me, happily eating from her bowl, enjoying rice and other dishes except the West Lake vinegar fish. She looks bright, playful, relaxed, cute.

From first-person POV, I pick up one bite of the fish with chopsticks and slowly extend it toward her. She notices it immediately, trusts me, leans forward, opens her mouth happily, and makes a cute “aam” sound as she bites the fish. I gently pull the chopsticks and my hand back out of frame.

She chews happily for about one second, expecting it to taste good. Then the taste hits. Her expression changes instantly into exaggerated but believable disgust. Her face shifts into a comedic purple-disgust reaction while staying within realistic live-action style. She quickly turns toward the lake and spits it out with repeated “ptui, ptui, ptui” sounds. The motion is fast, fluid, and continuous from chewing to rejection.

The moment she starts spitting, I begin laughing in first-person POV and keep laughing through the whole reaction. My laughter sounds genuine, amused, and uncontrollable, coming from behind the camera. The camera shakes slightly from laughing.

After spitting, @ Image1 sticks out her tongue in disgust, immediately grabs the water on the table

variants.text:
写实真人实拍，单镜头连续拍摄，全程第一人称 POV，无剪辑，无角度切换，无场景过渡，无蒙太奇，无闪切，无背景音乐，无字幕。仅包含两个角色：我（不可见的第一人称 POV）以及坐在我对面的 @ Image1。仅保留自然环境音：轻微的餐厅噪音、餐具声、远处的水声、微弱的人声、咀嚼声、吐痰声、漱口声以及我的笑声。

场景：
杭州西湖边的一张户外餐桌，靠近水边，平静的日光或柔和的午后光线。真实的手机拍摄质感，扎实的纹理，逼真的食物，真实的身体和手部动作，准确的筷子使用，准确的口型，准确的视线焦点。湖泊始终在画面一侧可见。

角色：
@ Image1 是唯一可见的人物。她可以在“微凶萌”和“软萌”之间无缝切换。口型同步、声音、表情和肢体语言保持完全一致。情感弧线：进食时欢快放松，随后感到震惊厌恶，最后是愤怒的尴尬。

餐桌：
桌上正好有 7 道菜。其中一道是 @ Image2 中展示的西湖醋鱼。@ Image1 正在愉快地吃米饭和其他菜肴，起初并未吃鱼。餐桌看起来很丰盛但布局清晰。在我要喂她之前，鱼这道菜始终清晰可见。

镜头：
整个视频均从我坐在桌对面的第一人称视角拍摄。我的手和筷子可能会自然地进入画面。仅有因呼吸和笑声引起的轻微手持晃动，绝不杂乱。没有第三人称镜头，没有反打镜头，没有俯拍镜头，没有切出画面。持续且可信的构图，画面中心为 @ Image1，并能看到部分湖景。

动作：
@ Image1 坐在我对面，愉快地从碗里吃饭，享受着除西湖醋鱼外的其他菜肴。她看起来明亮、俏皮、放松且可爱。

从第一人称 POV 出发，我用筷子夹起一块鱼，慢慢伸向她。她立刻注意到了，出于信任，她身体前倾，开心地张开嘴，发出可爱的“啊呜”声吃下鱼肉。我轻轻地将筷子和手移出画面。

她愉快地咀嚼了大约一秒钟，以为味道不错。随后味道袭来，她的表情瞬间转变为夸张但可信的厌恶。她的脸部转变为滑稽的“紫色厌恶”反应，同时保持写实的真人风格。她迅速转向湖边，伴随着连续的“呸、呸、呸”声将鱼吐出。从咀嚼到拒绝的动作快速、流畅且连续。

在她开始吐出食物的瞬间，我以第一人称 POV 开始大笑，并在她整个反应过程中持续大笑。我的笑声听起来真实、愉悦且无法自控，来自镜头后方。镜头因笑声而轻微晃动。

吐完后，@ Image1 厌恶地伸出舌头，立即抓起桌上的水。

prompt:
Cinematic short film, photorealistic VFX. 15-second desert hunt at high noon. Blinding light, zero shade, heat shimmer on everything.

[0–2s] Overhead drone — red desert canyon system. Sandstone towers, wind-carved arches, dry riverbeds. One figure: a woman on a sand-skiff — a flat wooden board with a triangular sail, gliding across compacted sand on bone runners. She wears wrapped linen armor, copper goggles, a weighted net coiled at her waist. She watches the sand.

[2–4s] ECU the sand surface — it's BREATHING. Rippling outward from a point 200 yards ahead. The sand rises like a slow dome. The sail-woman cuts the skiff hard right. The dome ERUPTS — a sandworm. 40 feet, segmented, chitinous plates the color of rust. Its mouth is a vertical iris lined with grinding teeth like a rock crusher. Sand cascades off its body. It roars — the sound is DEEP, below human hearing, but you feel it shake the frame.

[4–7s] Chase through the canyon — the skiff banks between sandstone pillars. The worm follows UNDERGROUND — you see its path as a moving ridge of sand, smashing through the earth, pillars cracking as it passes beneath their foundations. She throws the weighted net — it wraps around a sandstone tower, rope trailing to her skiff.

[7–10s] The worm surfaces directly in the skiff's path. She leans the board, catches wind, and the skiff JUMPS — airborne over the worm's back. In mid-air she drives a barbed stake into the top of its head plate. Lands the skiff on the other side. Rope connects stake to the sandstone tower.

[10–13s] The worm charges away — the rope goes taut against the tower. The tower HOLDS. The worm's momentum whiplashes it sideways. It crashes into a canyon wall. Sandstone debris cascades. Dust cloud erupts like a bomb. Silence inside the cloud.

[13–15s] Dust settles. The worm lies against the canyon wall, breathing but pinned. She brings the skiff alongside, pulls her goggles up. Beneath the goggles — calm, focused eyes. She draws a curved knife and begins cutting a single iridescent scale from the worm's flank — the harvest. That's all she came for. One scale. The worm hisses but doesn't fight. She pats its flank once, takes the scale, pushes off. The skiff catches wind. She vanishes between the sandstone towers. Cut to black. Ultra-realistic.

variants.text:
电影级短片，照片级写实视觉特效。正午时分 15 秒沙漠狩猎。强光刺眼，毫无遮蔽，万物笼罩在热浪之中。

[0–2 秒] 俯拍无人机视角 —— 红色沙漠峡谷系统。砂岩塔、风蚀拱门、干涸河床。画面中出现一人：一名女子驾驶着一艘沙地帆船 —— 一块带有三角帆的平坦木质项目，在压实的沙地上依靠骨质滑轨滑行。她身穿亚麻缠绕式护甲，佩戴铜制护目镜，腰间盘绕着一张负重网。她注视着沙面。

[2–4 秒] 特写沙面 —— 沙子在“呼吸”。从前方 200 码处向外泛起涟漪。沙地像一个缓慢隆起的圆顶。帆船女子猛地向右转舵。圆顶“爆发” —— 一条沙虫破土而出。体长 40 英尺，分节，甲壳呈锈色。它的嘴部是一个垂直的虹膜状结构，布满了像碎石机一样的研磨齿。沙子从它身上倾泻而下。它发出咆哮 —— 声音极其低沉，低于人类听觉范围，但你能感受到它震动了整个画面。

[4–7 秒] 峡谷追逐 —— 帆船在砂岩柱之间倾斜穿行。沙虫在地下紧追不舍 —— 你可以看到它行进的路径是一道移动的沙脊，它在地下横冲直撞，所过之处地基开裂，石柱崩塌。她掷出负重网 —— 网缠绕在一座砂岩塔上，绳索拖在她的帆船后。

[7–10 秒] 沙虫直接在帆船前方破土而出。她倾斜项目，借风加速，帆船“跳跃”而起 —— 从沙虫背上飞跃而过。在半空中，她将一根带刺的木桩钉入沙虫头部的甲板上。帆船在另一侧着陆。绳索将木桩与砂岩塔连接在一起。

[10–13 秒] 沙虫向前冲刺 —— 绳索在塔身处绷紧。塔身“稳固”。沙虫的惯性使其侧向甩动。它撞向峡谷壁。砂岩碎片四溅。尘埃云像炸弹一样爆发。云雾中一片死寂。

[13–15 秒] 尘埃落定。沙虫靠在峡谷壁上，虽然还在呼吸但已被固定。她将帆船靠过去，摘下护目镜。护目镜下是一双冷静、专注的眼睛。她拔出一把弯刀，开始从沙虫的侧腹切割一片虹彩鳞片 —— 这就是收获。她此行目的仅此而已。一片鳞片。沙虫发出嘶嘶声，但不再反抗。她拍了拍它的侧腹，取走鳞片，推开帆船。帆船兜满风，她消失在砂岩塔之间。画面切黑。超写实。

The camera glides steadily forward at chest height, as if walking through time, while the coastal landscape and city evolve dramatically around it over 10,000 years. Color Grade: Soft dawn blues to warm earth tones to fiery sunset oranges to cool neon cyans to sterile white-silver, each era bleeding smoothly into the next.  Lighting: Natural daylight shifting to torchlight, gaslight, electric grids, holographic glow, and finally starlight — the illumination evolves with human progress.  Camera: Constant slow forward dolly movement. No lateral pans, no tilts. Seamless transitions through shared elements: shoreline becomes harbor becomes docks becomes launch platforms.  [TIMELINE — CONTINUOUS FORWARD DOLLY]  0-2s: PREHISTORIC SETTLEMENT. Glide forward along a wild rocky coastline at dawn. Simple thatched huts and stone circles assemble from scattered boulders and driftwood. Small fishing boats carve from logs on the beach. Olive groves and vineyards bloom rapidly along the advancing path.  4-6s: MEDIEVAL TRADE CITY. Stone walls and wooden structures give way to fortified castles and Gothic cathedrals. Cobblestone streets lay themselves underfoot. Markets assemble with colorful tents and horse-drawn carts. A grand harbor expands with larger galleons; cranes hoist cargo as the camera passes through sea spray and lantern light.  6-8s: INDUSTRIAL HARBOR. Cobblestones become paved roads. Brick factories and iron bridges replace medieval spires. Steamships and early railways emerge along the waterfront. Smokestacks rise, billowing dark plumes that fade into the next era. Warehouses and cranes multiply on both sides.  8-10s: MODERN METROPOLIS. Industrial grit transforms into sleek concrete and steel. Skyscrapers shoot upward in glass and chrome. Neon signs and digital billboards ignite sequentially as the city pulses with energy.  10-13s: NEAR-FUTURE MEGACITY. Glass towers evolve into towering arcologies with vertical gardens and glowing energy shields. Flying vehicles and maglev pods weave overhead. Holographic advertisements float in the air. The harbor fills with autonomous ships and floating platforms. Bioluminescent lights and drone swarms illuminate the scene.  13-15s: SPACE COLONY LAUNCH. The dense cityscape parts to reveal vast launch complexes on reclaimed land. Massive orbital elevators and starships stand ready.

path: prompts/真人/现实向/剧情短片/youmind-3362--地下水晶洞穴磁悬浮竞速.md
prompt:
Start inside the mouth of a colossal underground cavern as the camera rushes forward and drops in a spiraling dive into the depths. Below, a mag-lev racing pod hurtles along a natural crystal rail formation deep underground, banking through impossible geological curves.

Its design is minimal and luminous: a teardrop-shaped transparent cockpit revealing the pilot within, magnetic suspension rings that pulse electric blue, no visible propulsion — just pure electromagnetic force, and a surface so polished it mirrors the crystal walls rushing past.

Giant amethyst and quartz formations blur by in streaks of purple and white while the pod's magnetic field makes the crystals around it resonate and sing. Without a cut, the camera tightens from the cavern-wide dive into a close chase along the crystal rail, revealing the pod's reflection fractured across a thousand crystal facets, electrical arcs jumping between the magnetic rings and nearby mineral deposits, and the crystal formations vibrating visibly, emitting harmonic tones.

It drops below the rail for a dramatic undercarriage shot revealing the magnetic suspension gap — a thin line of pure blue-white energy — then whips to the front as the cavern opens into a massive geode chamber. For the climax, the crystal rail splits into three diverging paths around a central formation — an enormous singular crystal, twenty meters tall, glowing from within with trapped ancient light.

The pod accelerates toward the fork, then at the last instant detaches from the rail entirely, going airborne through the geode chamber. It clips the giant crystal as it passes — the crystal shatters in slow motion, releasing its trapped light in a blinding prismatic explosion that fills the cavern with rainbow fire. The pod rides the light-blast's shockwave upward through a vertical shaft and erupts from a mountainside into daylight.

The camera spirals outward for one final epic reveal — the mountain exhaling a column of rainbow light into the sky.

variants.text:
从巨大的地下洞穴入口开始，镜头向前疾冲，随后螺旋俯冲进入深处。下方，一辆磁悬浮赛车正沿着地底天然形成的水晶轨道飞驰，在不可思议的地质弯道中倾斜穿行。

其设计极简且充满光感：泪滴状的透明驾驶舱内隐约可见飞行员，磁悬浮环闪烁着电光蓝，没有可见的推进装置——仅靠纯粹的电磁力，其表面光洁如镜，映照出飞速掠过的水晶岩壁。

巨大的紫水晶和石英结构化作紫色与白色的光影掠过，赛车的磁场使周围的水晶产生共鸣并发出鸣响。镜头一镜到底，从洞穴全景俯冲紧跟至水晶轨道上的近距离追逐，展现出赛车倒影在千万个水晶切面上破碎的效果，电弧在磁环与附近的矿床之间跳跃，水晶结构清晰可见地颤动，发出谐波音调。

镜头下潜至轨道下方，拍摄到底盘的戏剧性特写，露出磁悬浮间隙——那是一道纯净的蓝白色能量细线——随后迅速切换到前方，洞穴豁然开朗，进入一个巨大的晶洞空间。高潮部分，水晶轨道在中央结构处分叉为三条路径——那是一块高达 20 米的巨大单体水晶，内部闪烁着被封存的远古之光。

赛车向分叉处加速，在最后一刻完全脱离轨道，腾空飞入晶洞空间。它在经过时擦过巨型水晶——水晶慢动作破碎，释放出被封存的光芒，形成一场耀眼的棱镜爆炸，将整个洞穴填满彩虹般的火光。赛车乘着光爆的冲击波沿垂直竖井向上冲刺，最终从山腰破壁而出，冲向日光。

镜头向外螺旋拉开，呈现出最终的史诗级画面——山体向天空喷涌出一道彩虹光柱。

ローアングルからの高速トラッキングショットと安定したプッシュイン。青い瞳の長身の金髪バレエダンサーが、「ブラックスワン」の姿で上空からドラマチックに舞い降りる。より華やかで威圧的な存在感。回転して着地する際、その動きには明確な攻撃性が宿り、衝撃は重く鋭く、緊張感に満ちた正確なボディコントロールを見せる。羽が黒い刃のように空中に舞い散る。
照明は冷たくコントラストの強いトーンに切り替わり、鋭いハイライトが彼女のシルエットを縁取り、危険な雰囲気を醸し出す。観客は歓声とどよめきに包まれる。
カット—
リングの中央にそびえ立つボクサー（赤いトランクス、赤いグローブ、野獣のようなマウスガード）。圧倒的なプレッシャーを放つ。ゴリラのように胸を叩き、傲慢に笑いながら挑発する。

ゴングが鋭く鳴り響く様子を極端なクローズアップで捉える。リングへハードカット。
ボクサーが重いパンチを繰り出すが、ブラックスワンは極端なバックベンドで回避し、即座に反撃を開始する：
素早いハイキック、続いて連続的な回転蹴りと鋭い足技。彼女の動きはより鋭く、より攻撃的で、加速するテンポで絶え間なく攻め立てる。その動作は優雅でありながら野性的でもある。

K.O.
観客が割れんばかりの歓声を上げる。ブラックスワンはゆっくりと構えを解き、スポットライトの中央に立つ。彼女は気高い黒鳥のように優雅にお辞儀をする。

低角度快速跟拍，镜头平稳推进。一位高挑的蓝眼睛金发芭蕾舞者以“黑天鹅”姿态从天而降——气场华丽且极具压迫感。当她旋转落地时，动作带有明显的攻击性；冲击力沉重而锐利，身体控制精准且充满张力。羽毛如黑色利刃般在空中散落。
灯光转为冷色调的高对比度风格，锐利的高光勾勒出她的轮廓，营造出危险的氛围。观众席爆发出欢呼与惊叹声。

一位身材魁梧的拳击手站在拳击台中央（红色短裤，红色拳套，野兽风格护齿），散发着压迫感。他像大猩猩一样捶打胸口，傲慢地大笑，充满蔑视与挑衅。

拳击铃声响起，特写镜头锐利。硬切回拳击台。

快速上踢，紧接着连续旋转踢和横扫腿。她的动作更加锐利、更具侵略性，节奏不断加快，攻势连绵不绝。她的动作既优雅又狂野。
拳击手完全处于下风，被迫进入防御状态，步步后退，动作变得凌乱。
终结技——在高速旋转后，黑天鹅踢出一记强力的横向鞭腿（带有极强的动能和破空冲击力），将拳击手高高踢飞，随后重重摔在地上。

观众席爆发出雷鸣般的欢呼。黑天鹅缓缓收势，站在聚光灯中心。她如高贵的黑天鹅般优雅地鞠躬。

prompt:
TITLE: “No Ticket, No Problem”
Seedance 2 | 15-second cinematic action-comedy | jungle adventure parody | high-speed chaos | dark American humor dialogue | exaggerated reactions | dynamic camera | punchy sound design

A rugged jungle theme park entrance. Primitive wooden fences, tall gates, and a massive hanging wooden sign reading “CAT UNIVERSE.” Lush overgrown jungle beyond. Mist in the air. Subtle ominous ambiance.

An orange cat wearing khaki explorer gear, binoculars hanging around his neck, sits in a dusty jeep. A white cat in a pink dress sits in the back seat, clearly unimpressed.

0–3 seconds:
Wide shot. Jeep rolls to a stop at the gate. Jungle sounds echo.

A hyena guard in camouflage uniform and sunglasses steps forward, stern and silent.

He leans toward the driver side.

Hyena guard (flat, intimidating):
"Ticket."

Close-up on orange cat. Confident smile… slowly fades.

He starts searching frantically.

3–6 seconds:
Interior chaotic close shots.

Glove compartment bursts open—papers, snack wrappers, empty cans flying everywhere.

Orange cat digging everywhere. Increasing panic.

Orange cat (nervous laugh):
"Okay… funny story… I definitely had it… spiritually."

Cut to white cat in backseat, staring out the window, bored and annoyed.

White cat (dry):
"I knew this date was illegal."

Orange cat freezes. Looks at guard.

Orange cat (awkward):
"Yeah so… about the ticket… I don’t have it."

Beat. Silence.

6–9 seconds:
Sudden shift.

Orange cat slams the gas pedal.

ENGINE ROARS.

The jeep EXPLODES forward—

SMASHES through the wooden gate. Splinters fly in slow motion.

Hyena guard jumps back shouting.

Hyena guard:
"HEY— THAT’S NOT A VALID—"

Cut off by chaos.

The jeep speeds into the jungle.

White cat SCREAMS as she grabs the seat.

White cat:
"OH GREAT NOW WE’RE CRIMINALS—"

9–12 seconds:
Deep jungle. Camera racing alongside jeep.

Glowing floating bubbles fill the air—each one softly pulsing with different colors.

Inside each bubble: a sleeping tiny green baby T-rex.

The jeep rushes past—

Wind pressure disturbs the bubbles.

POP—POP—POP—

Bubbles burst rapidly.

Tiny T-rexes drop, wake up instantly—eyes glowing, teeth bared.

They SCREECH and begin chasing the jeep.

Fast chaotic pursuit.

White cat sighs, completely over it.

White cat (annoyed, deadpan):
"See? This is why I can’t let you make decisions."

12–15 seconds:
She reaches behind the seat—

Pulls out a ROCKET LAUNCHER casually.

Orange cat glances back, concerned.

Orange cat:
"...you brought that on a date?"

White cat shrugs.

White cat:
"I like options."

She fires.

WHOOSH—

Rocket splits mid-air into multiple flaming fragments.

Each fragment targets a different baby T-rex.

Rapid impacts—tiny explosions.

The T-rexes yelp, panic, scatter and flee in all directions.

Silence returns except for engine hum.

Final shot:
Inside jeep.

标题：《没票？没问题》
Seedance 2 | 15 秒电影级动作喜剧 | 丛林冒险戏仿 | 高速混乱 | 黑色美式幽默对白 | 夸张反应 | 动态镜头 | 强有力的音效设计

一个粗犷的丛林主题公园入口。原始的木栅栏、高大的大门，以及一块巨大的悬挂木牌，上面写着“猫咪宇宙” (CAT UNIVERSE)。远处是郁郁葱葱的丛林。空气中弥漫着薄雾。氛围略显诡异。

一只穿着卡其色探险装备、脖子上挂着望远镜的橘猫坐在尘土飞扬的吉普车里。一只穿着粉色裙子的白猫坐在后座，显然对此毫无兴趣。

0–3 秒：
广角镜头。吉普车在门口停下。丛林中回荡着阵阵声响。

一名穿着迷彩服、戴着墨镜的鬣狗守卫走上前来，神情严肃且沉默。

他向驾驶座一侧倾身。

鬣狗守卫（语气平淡，充满威胁）：
“票。”

橘猫特写。自信的微笑……逐渐消失。

他开始疯狂地翻找。

3–6 秒：
车内混乱的特写镜头。

手套箱弹开——纸张、零食包装纸、空罐头飞得到处都是。

橘猫到处乱翻。恐慌感加剧。

橘猫（尴尬地笑）：
“好吧……说来话长……我绝对是带了……在精神层面上。”

切换到后座的白猫，盯着窗外，一脸无聊和烦躁。

白猫（冷淡地）：
“我就知道这次约会不合法。”

橘猫僵住了。看向守卫。

橘猫（尴尬）：
“那个……关于票的事……我没带。”

停顿。一片寂静。

6–9 秒：
突变。

橘猫猛踩油门。

引擎轰鸣。

吉普车猛地冲了出去——

撞碎了木门。木屑在慢动作中飞溅。

鬣狗守卫向后跳开，大喊道。

鬣狗守卫：
“嘿——那不是有效的——”

声音被混乱掩盖。

吉普车冲进丛林。

白猫尖叫着抓住座椅。

白猫：
“太棒了，现在我们成罪犯了——”

9–12 秒：
丛林深处。镜头跟随吉普车疾驰。

发光的漂浮气泡充斥着空气——每一个气泡都闪烁着不同的色彩。

每个气泡里：都有一只正在睡觉的绿色小霸王龙宝宝。

吉普车疾驰而过——

气压扰动了气泡。

砰——砰——砰——

气泡迅速破裂。

小霸王龙宝宝掉落，瞬间惊醒——双眼发光，露出獠牙。

它们尖叫着开始追逐吉普车。

快速混乱的追逐。

白猫叹了口气，完全受够了。

白猫（烦躁，面无表情）：
“看吧？这就是为什么我不能让你做决定。”

12–15 秒：
她伸手到座椅后——

随手掏出一个火箭发射器。

橘猫回头看了一眼，一脸担忧。

橘猫：
“……你约会带这个？”

白猫耸耸肩。

白猫：
“我喜欢多几个选择。”

她开火了。

嗖——

火箭在半空中分裂成多个燃烧的碎片。

每个碎片瞄准一只不同的霸王龙宝宝。

快速撞击——产生微小的爆炸。

霸王龙们哀鸣着，惊慌失措，四散奔逃。

除了引擎的嗡嗡声，一切归于平静。

最终镜头：
吉普车内。

Hands reach up, grab the saddle edge, pull up. One leg swings over. POV settles into the white saddle on the dragon's back. Hands grip the saddle straps. The rider says softly but firmly: "Are you ready, my friend?" 6s–8s: The dragon holds the gaze for one more beat, then slowly turns its head back forward toward the starting gate. The crowd noise builds. 8s–10s: The dragon lowers its body slightly, hind legs coiling, claws gripping the wooden platform, wings tucking tight against its body in launch position. Muscles tensing visibly under the scales. The rider leans forward flat against the neck, hands locked on the straps, body pressed tight. Both locked in, both ready. Crowd roaring. The starting gate still ahead. Freeze on the tension. Style: hyperrealistic VFX, photoreal massive dragon, detailed scales and eye, worn leather saddle and gloves, mountain competition environment, visceral POV, rider always firmly mounted, layered crowd and competition soundscape — cheering, distant horns, wind, dragon breathing — building to crescendo, no music. prompt: A hyper-realistic, high-octane cinematic epic set within the heart of an endless, undulating desert of scarlet sand. A colossal Desert Leviathan—a serpentine creature forged from ancient, hardened clay, bone, and pulsating veins of molten obsidian—violently explodes from the highest dune, breaching like a whale but through the earth itself. It sprays tsunamis of fine red sand high into the scorching air. Riding the apex of the Leviathan’s churning, scaly head is an ethereal belly dancer, draped in shimmering silk veils embedded with tiny mirrors and raw amber. Instead of trying to maintain balance, she embraces the creature's massive upward surge. She uses a golden, scimitar-shaped baton to weave the rising sand columns, drawing shimmering, fractal symbols of golden energy and glowing turquoise hieroglyphs from the creature’s hide, molding the flying sand into solid steps beneath her feet. The Twist: As the Leviathan roars—a sound like tectonic plates grinding beneath a waterfall—the entire desert landscape undergoes a sudden, localized environmental shift. The intense, oppressive heat violently transforms into an immediate, freezing flash-frost. The cascading waves of scarlet sand begin to solidify in mid-air, not into ice, but into geometric crystals of amethyst. Suddenly, a massive, explosive swarm of origami scarabs (folded from iridescent blue metal and paper) erupts from the frozen dunes, soaring like arrows all around the suspended dancer. The camera abandons a traditional perspective for a kinetic, fast-paced whip-pan tracking shot, following the dancer’s flight as she leaps from crystal sand-step to crystal sand-step, navigating the dangerous amethyst terrain and dodging the swarm of metal scarabs. She dives headfirst toward the creature’s open, frozen maw. Lighting & Atmosphere: The lighting is a conflict of extremes. The initial setting is scorched by a high-noon, harsh yellow sun. This is instantly replaced by the oppressive, cool, deep violet shadows of the flash-frozen desert and the refracted, kaleidoscopic colors bouncing off the amethyst crystals and metal scarabs. Audio Profile: The scene begins with a deafening, low-frequency rumble of shifting earth and the sickening crack of ancient wood. The Shaman’s magic hums with a pulsating, rhythmic chant layered with the crackling of siphoned electricity. When the frost-ravens erupt, the sound shifts to the shrieking, high-pitched scratching of ice on ice. A chaotic, primal drum score drives the action, cutting to absolute sonic vacuum just as the Shaman breaches the frozen breath, leaving only the sound of a single, slow heartbeat.

Asian adult male based exactly on the reference (@Image1).

Solid white and dark-green komodo-type armor, fully mechanical. Based on reference @image2

Gold vertical pupils, purple energy circuits.

0–1s
The hero sprints across a frozen street, escaping.
Beasts close in from three sides. Armor modules streak in from all directions.

1–2.5s – Feet
Boot modules slam onto his left foot and ankle.

2.5–4s – Legs
Leg armor locks in. He accelerates and leaps onto a structure, dodging pursuit.

4–5.5s – Waist
Hip armor connects. He pivots and jumps walls using terrain to escape.

5.5–7s – Torso
Iron Man armor seals across abdomen and ribs as he slides under a truck.

7–8s – Chest/Back
Chest and spine armor lock. He blocks a claw strike mid-motion.

8–9s – Arms
Arm modules attach. He clenches his fist, preparing a counterattack.

9–10s – Helmet
A komodo-shaped helmet seals over his head. Golden eyes ignite.

10–12s – Clash
Beasts leap in. He spins, blocks, and throws one into burning debris.

12–14.5s – Final Strike
He dashes forward, grabs a monster’s joint, and delivers a powerful palm strike.

He slides into a half-kneeling stance, surrounded by snow, fire, and wreckage—
a frozen hero shot in a silent, devastated world.

光影完全写实——深邃的对比度、体积雾、冰面与金属的反射、强烈的景深效果。

完全基于参考图（@Image1）的亚洲成年男性。

野兽扑来。他旋转、格挡，并将其中一只扔进燃烧的残骸中。

他向前冲刺，抓住怪物的关节，并打出强力的一掌。

0-2s: Sweeping low aerial shot racing toward blazing village. Silver-haired female warrior (early 20s, short choppy silver-white hair, glowing emerald eyes, fierce expression) sprints fast, green cape whipping. Silver plate armor over green tunic, gauntlets, boots. Voice: “Too slow.”

2-5s: Tracking shot from behind as she leaps, cape flaring like wings. Massive shadowy creature (long black hair, glowing green eyes, claws, purple-dark armor, bat wings) erupts from smoke and slams past in blur. She spins mid-air.

5-8s: Close-up warrior face, focused and sweaty. She raises hands in martial stance, green energy swirls. Summons massive white tornado upward. Creature dives; she blocks with crossed arms, cape billowing. Heroic low-angle against its wing.

8-11s: Extreme wide: warrior launched high in tornado. Mid-air collision with creature, tumbling spin. Tight face-to-face glare: her determined vs its snarling purple face. Creature hisses “You don’t belong here.” Sparks explode. Slow-mo grapple.

11-15s: Rapid cuts: she spins, kicks free, backflips, launches wind blast. Creature transforms into larger spiked dragon-beast with red spine accents and long tail. Epic wide aerial fight under moon, dust tornadoes and embers below.

15-19s: Fast montage: warrior dodges whipping tail, runs along it mid-air, leaps off with wind boost. Close-up glowing green eye and armored hand charging energy. She slams creature’s side in burst of orange sparks and smoke. Creature roars away.

19-23s: Dramatic close-up on warrior’s face (messy hair, burning green eyes, small confident smirk). Distant creature rises glowing green in smoke. Voice: “Round two.” Slow push-in as embers drift, village glows behind hills. Fade to black.

Style: Consistent designs — warrior pale skin, sharp jaw, athletic; creature ethereal menacing with flowing hair/claws. Deep blue-cyan grading with warm firelight. Detailed cape physics, armor reflections, wind/sparks/smoke particles. Arcane-style fluid choreography. Lip sync, wind howls, impacts, fire crackle.

A colossal Storm-Wyrm—a serpentine dragon forged from turbulent thunderclouds and internal lattice-works of blue lightning—violently erupts from a dry riverbed, breaching like a whale through the canyon floor. It sends explosive shockwaves of pulverized red sandstone and electrified dust high into the storm-choked sky.

Riding the apex of the Storm-Wyrm's rugged, crackling snout is a modernized Shaolin Monk, clad in robes woven with conductive wire and armored boots. A massive, explosive swarm of flying, magnetic iron-ore gargoyles (carved from the cliff face itself) is ripped from the rock, soaring like kinetic missiles all around the suspended monk.

The camera perspective shifts from a high-angle wide to a kinetic, fast-paced spiraling FPV drone-style tracking shot. The camera corkscrews 360 degrees around the monk’s spin, tracking his leg trajectory through the static-filled dust as he smashes through the gargoyles and weaves between the lightning-filled air. The shot then plunges momentarily into a thick cloud bank just as the Storm-Wyrm’s massive, spade-like tail slams down into the canyon floor with catastrophic force. The cool, flickering blue static light is dramatically pierced by a sudden, jagged bolt of crimson lightning tearing across the dark sky.

prompt:
Anime style, Makoto Shinkai, cozy kitchen, warm sunlight through window, copper pots on shelves. Side and top-down camera alternating. Final reference: green matcha roll cake with pink strawberry cream filling, topped with grapes, watermelon slice, pearl beads, held on white plate.
Strict sequence:
Eggs cracked into bowl — whisk beats with sugar until pale and fluffy, ribbons form.
Matcha powder and flour sifted over egg mixture — green cloud settles, folded gently with spatula.
Warm milk and butter poured in — folded until smooth vivid green batter.
Batter poured onto flat baking sheet lined with parchment — spread evenly thin with spatula.
Sheet placed in oven — warm glow, timer set.
Sponge removed — thin green sheet, springy surface. Placed on clean parchment, rolled loosely while warm — sets the shape. Unrolled gently.
Strawberries sliced on board — thin even pieces.
Heavy cream whipped in bowl — pink food coloring added, whipped to stiff peaks, pink cream formed.
Pink cream spread generously across entire green sponge surface — spatula smooth strokes.
Strawberry slices laid in even row across cream.
Sponge rolled tightly from one end — both hands roll firmly and evenly, parchment guides the roll.
Rolled cake wrapped in parchment, refrigerated — hands press ends flat.
Roll unwrapped — placed on white plate. Pink mirror glaze poured over top — glossy pink coat drips down sides.
Green grapes placed on top center.
Watermelon slice wedge placed beside grapes. Pearl beads placed around base. Hands lift plate toward window — sunlight catches glaze.
Sounds only: whisk, batter spread, oven hum, cream whipping, rolling, glaze pour. 15 seconds. Gentle flowing pacing.

variants.text:
动漫风格，新海诚，温馨厨房，温暖阳光透过窗户，架子上摆放着铜锅。侧拍与俯拍镜头交替。最终参考：绿色抹茶卷蛋糕，内馅为粉色草莓奶油，顶部装饰有葡萄、西瓜片和珍珠糖珠，盛放在白色盘子中。
严格顺序：
鸡蛋打入碗中 —— 用打蛋器加入糖搅拌，直至颜色变浅、质地蓬松，呈现丝带状。
抹茶粉和面粉筛入蛋液 —— 绿色粉末如云朵般落下，用刮刀轻轻翻拌均匀。
倒入温牛奶和黄油 —— 翻拌至顺滑的鲜绿色面糊。
面糊倒入铺有烘焙纸的平烤盘中 —— 用刮刀抹平，厚度均匀。
烤盘放入烤箱 —— 温暖的光芒，设定定时器。
取出蛋糕胚 —— 绿色的薄片，表面富有弹性。放在干净的烘焙纸上，趁热轻轻卷起 —— 定型。然后轻轻展开。
在项目上切草莓 —— 切成薄而均匀的片状。
在碗中搅打淡奶油 —— 加入粉色食用色素，打发至硬性发泡，形成粉色奶油。
将粉色奶油均匀涂抹在整个绿色蛋糕胚表面 —— 用刮刀抹平。
将草莓片整齐地铺在奶油上。
从一端将蛋糕紧紧卷起 —— 双手用力均匀地卷动，利用烘焙纸引导卷制。
将卷好的蛋糕用烘焙纸包裹，放入冰箱冷藏 —— 双手压平两端。
拆开包装 —— 放在白色盘子上。淋上粉色镜面淋面 —— 光亮的粉色涂层顺着侧面滴落。
在顶部中心放置绿色葡萄。
在葡萄旁放置一片西瓜。在底部周围点缀珍珠糖珠。双手将盘子移向窗边 —— 阳光映照在淋面上。
仅保留环境音：打蛋声、涂抹面糊声、烤箱嗡嗡声、打发奶油声、卷制声、淋面声。15 秒。节奏轻柔流畅。

path: prompts/真人/特效向/动作大片/youmind-3450--天穹裂变-生物机械女武神动作大片.md
prompt:
The Celestial Fracture: A Supernova Strike

A hyper-realistic, high-octane cinematic video that demands absolute attention. A colossal, biomechanical Stained-Glass Cerberus—its internal skeleton forged from churning, liquid tungsten—violently crashes upward through the vaulted floor of a floating, neo-gothic cathedral suspended in the chaotic rings of a dying star. The breach sends explosive, slow-motion shockwaves of pulverized ancient marble and iridescent glass shards high into the localized anti-gravity field.

Riding the apex of the center hound's massive skull is a fiercely athletic Valkyrie, armored in polished obsidian and wielding a colossal scythe made of pure, white-hot plasma. Instead of bracing for the catastrophic impact, she harnesses the beast's violent upward momentum to launch into a spectacular, gravity-defying reverse-somersault execution strike, swinging the glowing plasma scythe overhead in a blinding, lethal arc directly toward the abyss.

The Twist:
Suddenly, an unexpected twist: as the Cerberus reaches the peak of its breach, the millions of suspended, shattered stained-glass fragments violently ignite with blinding, golden solar energy. The shards instantly coalesce and mutate into a massive swarm of glowing, translucent Celestial Manta Rays, their wings sharp as obsidian scalpels, erupting from the debris and soaring like kinetic missiles all around the suspended warrior.

The camera abandons a traditional wide shot for a relentless, fast-paced reverse-tracking snap-zoom. It spirals violently backward through the deadly storm of glowing glass manta rays, narrowly dodging their razor-sharp wings, before whipping 180 degrees to lock into a first-person POV directly over the Valkyrie's shoulder just as her plasma scythe connects with the Cerberus’s tungsten spine with catastrophic force. The blinding golden light of the dying star is dramatically pierced by a sudden, jagged shockwave of void-black anti-matter ripping across the nebula.

Audio Profile:
Audio features the deafening, apocalyptic crunch of shattering celestial architecture, the high-pitched, singing whine of the plasma scythe cutting the atmosphere, the terrifyingly beautiful, chaotic chime of a million glass wings slicing the air, and a soaring, high-tempo operatic choir layered with a heavy synth-bass crescendo. This auditory chaos cuts abruptly to a vacuum-sealed, ringing silence the exact millisecond the black anti-matter shockwave detonates.

variants.text:
天穹裂变：超新星打击

这是一段极具视觉冲击力、节奏紧凑的超写实电影级视频。一只巨大的生物机械“彩绘玻璃刻耳柏洛斯”——其内部骨架由翻涌的液态钨锻造而成——猛烈地向上撞破了一座悬浮在垂死恒星混乱光环中的新哥特式大教堂拱顶。这次撞击将粉碎的古老大理石和虹彩玻璃碎片以慢动作引发爆炸性冲击波，抛向局部的反重力场中。

在那只居中猎犬巨大的头骨顶端，站着一位身姿矫健的女武神，她身披抛光黑曜石盔甲，挥舞着一把由纯净、炽热的等离子体构成的巨大镰刀。她没有为灾难性的撞击做准备，而是利用野兽猛烈向上的动量，腾空跃起，完成了一个壮观的、无视重力的后空翻处决打击，将发光的等离子镰刀在头顶挥出一道耀眼、致命的弧线，直指深渊。

转折：
突然，意想不到的转折发生了：当刻耳柏洛斯冲至撞击顶峰时，数百万悬浮的破碎彩绘玻璃碎片猛然点燃，迸发出耀眼的金色太阳能。碎片瞬间聚合并异变成一群发光的、半透明的“天穹蝠鲼”，它们的翅膀如黑曜石手术刀般锋利，从残骸中喷涌而出，像动力导弹一样在悬浮的战士周围穿梭。

镜头放弃了传统的广角拍摄，转而采用一种无情、快节奏的逆向追踪快拉变焦。镜头在发光的玻璃蝠鲼群中剧烈地向后盘旋，惊险地躲避着它们锋利的翅膀，随后猛地旋转 180 度，锁定在女武神肩后的第一人称视角，就在她的等离子镰刀以毁灭性的力量击中刻耳柏洛斯的钨金脊椎瞬间。垂死恒星耀眼的金色光芒被一道突然出现的、锯齿状的虚空黑色反物质冲击波剧烈撕裂，横扫整个星云。

音频配置：
音频包含天体建筑破碎时震耳欲聋的末日崩塌声、等离子镰刀切割大气时高亢的尖啸声、百万片玻璃翅膀划破空气时凄美而混乱的鸣响，以及伴随着重低音合成器渐强的高节奏歌剧合唱。当黑色反物质冲击波引爆的瞬间，所有听觉上的混乱戛然而止，转为真空般的死寂。

prompt:
[0-2s] A blonde/orange cat naps on the couch. The robot vacuum bumps into the couch leg. The cat looks down. Annoyed.
[2-4s] The cat drops a paw and pushes the vacuum away. It spins, recalculates, comes right back. Bumps the couch again.
[4-6s] The cat jumps down. Sits directly on top of it. The vacuum tries to move. Can't. Wheels spinning. Going nowhere.
[6-8s] The vacuum reverses hard. The cat slides off the back. Lands on its butt. Dignity gone.
[8-10s] The cat chases it. The vacuum dodges around a chair leg. Then another. The cat crashes into the chair.
[10-12s] The cat sits in the corner licking its paw pretending nothing happened. The vacuum bumps into it one more time. On purpose.

The cat stalks the vacuum across the room. Low. Predator mode. The vacuum is heading for the kitchen.
In the kitchen, vacuum wants to get on the dock and cat knows it. The cat jumps down. Sits right in front of the dock.
The vacuum tries left. The cat slides left. Tries right. The cat slides right. No way through.
a woman enters the kitchen and says "oh dear, it's running out of battery" and asks the cat to "get out of the way" so vacuum can enter dock. she places the vacuum and says "let him do his job"
Click. The vacuum docks. Light turns green. The cat looks at it with anger and throws a paw, the vacuum responds with a beep.

[0-2 秒] 一只橘猫在沙发上打盹。扫地机器人撞到了沙发腿。猫咪低头看了一眼，显得很烦躁。
[2-4 秒] 猫咪伸出一只爪子把扫地机器人推开。机器人旋转、重新规划路径，又转了回来。再次撞上沙发。
[4-6 秒] 猫咪跳下沙发，直接坐在了机器人上面。机器人试图移动，但动弹不得。轮子空转，原地打转。
[6-8 秒] 机器人猛地后退。猫咪从后面滑了下来，屁股着地。尊严全无。
[8-10 秒] 猫咪开始追逐机器人。机器人绕过一把椅子的腿，又绕过另一把。猫咪一头撞在了椅子上。
[10-12 秒] 猫咪坐在角落里舔着爪子，假装什么都没发生。机器人又撞了它一下。故意的。

猫咪在房间里跟踪着扫地机器人。压低身体，进入捕猎模式。机器人正朝厨房走去。
在厨房里，机器人想要回到充电座，而猫咪看穿了它的意图。猫咪跳下来，直接坐在充电座正前方。
机器人试图向左走，猫咪就向左滑；试图向右走，猫咪就向右滑。完全过不去。
一位女士走进厨房说：“噢天哪，它快没电了”，并让猫咪“让开”，好让机器人回到充电座。她把机器人放好并说道：“让他完成他的工作”。
咔哒一声。机器人成功对接。指示灯变绿。猫咪愤怒地盯着它并挥了一爪子，机器人发出“哔”的一声作为回应。

prompt:
Marrakech medina at golden hour. The sun hangs low and orange over terracotta rooftops, casting long copper shadows between tangled alleyways stacked with spice pyramids, hanging lanterns, and drying saffron threads. Dust motes swirl in shafts of light.
[0s–3s] Open on a tight overhead drone shot looking straight down into a narrow alley no wider than a man's shoulders. A young thief in a dust-colored linen shirt, bare feet slapping warm stone, bursts into frame sprinting full tilt. He clutches a small burlap pouch against his chest. The drone matches his speed, descending and tilting forward until it's level with the rooftops, revealing the vast medina maze unfolding beneath him.
[3s–6s] Smash cut to a steadicam chase shot, 24mm wide, framing him from behind at waist height. He vaults a cart of blood oranges — they cascade into frame, bouncing like liquid fire across stone. A pursuing merchant shouts in Darija, swinging a wooden cane. The camera ducks under a low arch covered in blue tilework, and a shaft of golden light sweeps across the lens in a blinding flare.
[6s–9s] Whip-pan to a lateral tracking shot as he scales a wall in three kinetic movements — foot on a crate, hand grabbing a copper pot hook, shoulder rolling onto a low roof. Hens explode into the air, feathers floating in slow motion. The camera rises with him in a vertical crane, revealing the full panorama: the pink Koutoubia mosque minaret in the distance, the Atlas Mountains silhouetted purple on the horizon, smoke rising from tagine stalls far below.
[9s–12s] Hard cut to extreme close-up of his face, intercut with the pouch opening mid-stride — a single raw emerald the size of a walnut tumbles out, catches the sunset, and he snatches it back out of the air without breaking pace. Sweat beads on his brow. His dark eyes flick sideways. A 35mm lens, shallow focus, background dissolving into amber bokeh.
[12s–15s] Reverse low-angle tracking shot, camera gliding backwards ahead of him across the rooftops. He leaps — a massive gap, at least four meters — between two buildings. Time stretches. His body arcs over the alley where, far below, a wedding procession plays ghaita horns and beats tbel drums, red petals falling. He lands in a perfect forward roll, springs up, and without pausing tosses the emerald into the air. Camera cranes up fast to catch it spinning against the blazing sun. Freeze frame. Silhouette. Cut to black.
STYLE: Sun-baked desert epic, Villeneuve-grade scale with Guy Ritchie kinetic cutting. Shot on Alexa Mini LF, Cooke S4 primes. Color grade: burnt sienna, warm amber highlights, turquoise accent shadows from tilework. Heavy atmospheric haze, volumetric sun rays, practical dust kicked up by every footfall. Minimal lens flare, no grain — crisp, cinematic, rich.
AUDIO: Breathy flute and hand-percussion tabla rhythm at 120 BPM building to a climax. Footsteps slapping stone. Distant call to prayer bleeding across rooftop

黄金时刻的马拉喀什麦地那。太阳低垂，在赤陶屋顶上洒下橙色的光辉，在堆满香料金字塔、悬挂灯笼和晾晒藏红花丝的错综复杂巷弄间投下长长的铜色阴影。尘埃在光束中飞舞。

prompt:
FORMAT
cinematic continuous shot / motivated camera movement / 15s
SCENE
A bustling Elizabethan-era market street in London, circa 1500s, at dusk. Timber-framed buildings lean over a narrow muddy street, upper floors nearly touching. Wooden market stalls overflow with bread, fish, herbs, and cloth. Butchers’ hooks hang with raw meat, barrels of ale line the road, and livestock—geese, chickens, and a stray pig—wander freely.
Vendors shout in the street, accents rough and lively. Smoke rises from chimneys, mixing with damp fog rolling in from the nearby River Thames. The ground is wet, reflecting torchlight and lantern glow in uneven puddles.
CAMERA CONCEPT
A continuous, motivated camera move where each subject’s motion naturally redirects attention—flowing like a living observer through the chaos of the market.
SEQUENCE
0:00–0:03
Close street-level view of a wooden stall stacked with apples and root vegetables.
CAMERA FOCUS: a cloaked woman argues over price with a merchant. She bites into an apple to test it, then reluctantly drops worn coins into his hand.
0:03–0:05
A horse-drawn cart loaded with sacks of grain suddenly splashes through muddy water across the foreground, briefly obscuring the scene.
CAMERA SHIFT: the camera picks up the cart and begins tracking alongside it.
0:05–0:07
The cart grinds through the tight street, brushing against a hanging cloth banner bearing a faded guild emblem. The fabric whips across the lens.
CAMERA SHIFT: as the cloth clears, a group of geese scatter loudly across the road.
0:07–0:09
A ragged street boy darts into frame, chasing the geese with a stick, weaving through townsfolk and baskets.
CAMERA SHIFT: the camera follows him, dodging passersby.
0:09–0:12
The boy rushes past the entrance of a dim tavern. He disappears into the crowd.
CAMERA SHIFT: the tavern door creaks open as a drunk patron stumbles out.
0:12–0:15
The camera glides past him and into the tavern interior. Thick smoke hangs in the air, lit by flickering oil lanterns. Rough wooden tables, spilled ale, murmuring voices.
CAMERA FINAL FOCUS: a silent armored figure sits in the corner—less polished knight, more worn mercenary—mud-stained boots, dented armor, a longsword resting against the bench. He slowly raises his eyes toward the camera.
STYLE
Authentic Elizabethan street life, dense crowd choreography, grounded realism, historically textured details.
LIGHTING
Warm torchlight reflecting in wet mud outside, cool fog diffusion, dim golden lantern glow inside, smoke-heavy atmosphere.
QUALITY
photorealistic, cinematic lighting, historically grounded detail, immersive camera flow, rich 1500s London atmosphere

キャラクターは「動き → 可愛いポーズで静止」というリズムのバリエーションを伴う、大きく高速な動きを繰り返す。

演出シーケンス：キャラクターは「動き → 可愛いポーズで静止」というリズムのバリエーションを伴う、大きく高速な動きを繰り返す。
顔のクローズアップ：
- 右上を見る → 左上を見る
- 顔を赤らめ、手で口元を隠しながらの悪戯っぽい笑み
- マンガ風の誇張された表情とジェスチャー
- 急激な引きのカメラワーク、強いパースを効かせたポーズ
- カメラに向かって手を突き出す短縮法（フォアショートニング）

カメラ：ダイナミックで躍動感のあるカット。強いパース、誇張されたアングル、キャラクター追従、急加速を組み合わせる。視聴者がリズムと「ビート」を視覚的に感じられるようにする。

アクションデザイン：肩、腰、脚を連動させ、胴体を大きくしならせる。しなやかさと爆発的なパワーを兼ね備える。荒々しくも洗練された、効率的な動き。

感情の流れ：集中 → 加速 → 没入 → 解放。緊張と陶酔が共存する表情の変化を明確に描く。

エフェクト：攻撃や動きの軌跡にシャープなエフェクト。衝突時に弾けるような視覚的リアクション。風圧や衝撃波で髪や衣装が大きく揺れる。「重量感」と「鋭さ」を瞬時に両立させる。

スローモーション：決定的な瞬間の直前、またはピーク時にのみ使用。時間を引き伸ばすことで、感情とインパクトを最大化する。

背景：キャンバスのように扱われた、ファンシーな室内ベース。

レイヤー優先順位：キャラクター、グラフィックパターン、白背景。

グラフィック要素：円、三角形、星、多角形、ソフトなブロブ（不定形）、ドットの集合体。フラットな塗り、シャープなエッジ、不透明、高コントラスト。カラーパレットはパステルカラーに限定。

モーション統合：キャラクターの動きやポーズに合わせてシェイプが動く。顔や重要なエリアを隠すことなく、視覚的なエネルギーを増幅させる。

構成デザイン：キャラクターに焦点を当てつつ、すべての要素を自然に統合する。キャラクターと背景の強いコントラストを維持する。

「こんな風に私を置いていくなんて、いろいろな意味でいい度胸ね！」

A stylized mountain path at dusk. Painted backdrop, flat perspective, overly vivid colors. Wind machines blow unevenly. Fake fog drifts across the ground.
A BLACK CAT with long white eyebrows, dressed as a calm wandering monk (loose beige robes, prayer beads), sits serenely atop a clearly fake WHITE TIGER prop (stiff, visible seams).
Beside him, an ORANGE CAT dressed as a rebellious staff-wielding trickster (gold headband, red outfit) hovers on a flickering cloud platform. He scans the area cautiously.
They pass a cave covered in thick cotton spider webs. From inside: eerie, exaggerated female laughter.
0–3 seconds:
Wide shot. Wind howls.
Black cat gently pats the tiger (it squeaks).
Black cat (calm):
"Night’s falling. This feels like a mistake worth making."
Orange cat squints at the cave.
Orange cat:
"Yeah, this is how people disappear. I’ll check."
Black cat nods.
3–6 seconds:
Orange cat raises one finger—
A cheap flashlight pops into his hand.
Orange cat (dry):
"If I don’t come back, avenge me… or at least pretend."
He glides into the cave on his cloud.
6–9 seconds:
Inside. Dark.
He pushes through webs, annoyed.
Orange cat:
"Great. Zero cleaning budget."
He spots light deeper inside—
Accelerates toward it.
9–12 seconds:
Reveal: fake garden set. Painted flowers, plastic plants.
GRAY CATS with heavy makeup and flowing white gauze outfits laugh and run theatrically.
One notices him.
Gray cat (cold):
"Look. A volunteer."
Orange cat drops down, staff appearing in hand.
Orange cat:
"Enough. Monsters don’t get warnings twice."
Fight burst:
He spins, strikes, flips—fast, flashy.
Gray cats effortlessly dodge, laughing.
Gray cats (mocking):
"Cute."
"He trained for this."
Orange cat frustrated—targets one—leaps for a finishing strike—
12–14 seconds:
Two fingers suddenly stop the staff mid-air.
Reveal: black cat behind him.
Black cat (gentle):
"We don’t harm the living."
Instant shift—
Gray cats turn grotesque and lunge at him.
14–15 seconds:
Black cat murmurs a chant. Golden light bursts outward.
Gray cats freeze, collapse, dissolve into black smoke.
Silence.
Orange cat lowers his staff, looks at camera.
Orange cat (deadpan):
"So when I hit them, it’s wrong…
but when you erase them, it’s wisdom?"
Black cat stays silent, peaceful.
Awkward beat.
Cut to black with a sharp comedic sting.

在他身旁，一只打扮成叛逆棍术捣蛋鬼的橘猫（戴着金色头箍，身穿红色套装）悬浮在闪烁的云朵平台上。他谨慎地扫视着周围。
他们经过一个覆盖着厚厚棉花蜘蛛网的洞穴。洞内传出阴森、夸张的女性笑声。
0–3 秒：
广角镜头。风声呼啸。
黑猫轻轻拍了拍老虎（老虎发出吱吱声）。
黑猫（冷静）：
“夜幕降临了。这感觉像是一个值得犯的错。”
橘猫眯着眼看向洞穴。
橘猫：
“是啊，人就是这么消失的。我去看看。”
黑猫点点头。
3–6 秒：
橘猫举起一根手指——
一把廉价手电筒突然出现在他手中。
橘猫（冷淡）：
“如果我没回来，替我报仇……或者至少装装样子。”
他乘着云朵滑进洞穴。
6–9 秒：
洞内。黑暗。
他拨开蛛网，一脸烦躁。
橘猫：
“太棒了。清洁预算为零。”
他发现深处有光——
加速冲向光亮处。
9–12 秒：
揭晓：虚假的园林布景。手绘花朵，塑料植物。
几只化着浓妆、穿着飘逸白纱装的灰猫在戏谑地大笑奔跑。
其中一只注意到了他。
灰猫（冷漠）：
“看。一个志愿者。”
橘猫落下，手中出现长棍。
橘猫：
“够了。怪物不会得到两次警告。”
战斗爆发：
他旋转、出击、翻滚——动作迅速、华丽。
灰猫们轻松躲避，发出嘲笑。
灰猫们（嘲讽）：
“真可爱。”
“他为此训练过呢。”
橘猫感到挫败——瞄准其中一只——跃起准备终结一击——
12–14 秒：
两根手指突然在半空中挡住了长棍。
揭晓：黑猫出现在他身后。
黑猫（温柔）：
“我们不伤害生灵。”
瞬间转变——
灰猫们变得狰狞，向他扑来。
14–15 秒：
黑猫低声吟唱。金光向外迸发。
灰猫们僵住、倒下，化作黑烟消散。
寂静。
橘猫放下长棍，看向镜头。
橘猫（面无表情）：
“所以当我打她们的时候就是错的……
但当你抹除她们的时候，就是智慧？”
黑猫保持沉默，神情安详。
尴尬的停顿。
切至黑屏，伴随一声尖锐的喜剧音效。

[0.0 – 1.2s]
The penguin-suit girl stands with a tiny pout, arms stiff, looking slightly annoyed.

[1.2 – 2.5s]

[2.5 – 3.5s]
The glowing heart floats toward penguin girl and gently boops her face.
Her cheeks turn pink, she looks shy and glances away.
Cat girl giggles, bouncing slightly in place.
[3.5 – 4.0s]
Penguin girl softly smiles (very subtle), tiny tail wiggle.
Both characters lean slightly closer together.
End with warm cozy freeze-frame feeling.

cute interaction, expressive faces, soft squash & stretch, subtle physics, floating VFX heart, cozy vibe, wholesome energy

static with slight handheld micro-movement, gentle focus breathing

warm indoor + cool blue window contrast, soft shadows, skin glow

prompt:
image1's character as the subject (dark superhero with glowing white eyes, batik cape, and smoke aura). The scene and enemy Dutch colonial soldiers on a Javanese street.

0–3s: Wide establishing shot from low angle looking up at the sky. The superhero from image1 hovers mid-air, dark smoke swirling around his body, batik cape flowing in the wind. Below, Dutch soldiers aim their rifles upward and fire. Muzzle flashes erupt. Bullets pass through the superhero harmlessly, dissolving into wisps of black smoke on contact. Camera slowly pushes in toward the floating figure.

4–8s: The superhero descends rapidly from the sky, landing with a heavy impact on the dirt road — a shockwave of black smoke radiates outward. Camera follows with a crane shot tilting down. The soldiers stagger back in fear, scrambling to reload. The superhero stands upright, glowing eyes piercing through the smoke. He begins walking toward the soldiers with supernatural speed.

9–13s: Fast-paced sequence — the superhero dashes from soldier to soldier with blur-speed movement. Each time he touches a soldier with his hand, the soldier instantly disintegrates into black smoke and vanishes completely. One touch, one vanish. Camera uses whip pans between each elimination, tracking the superhero's movement. Three to four soldiers dissolve in rapid succession.

13–15s: Final wide shot — the street is now empty, only lingering black smoke where the soldiers once stood. The superhero stands alone in the center of the road, smoke curling around him, glowing eyes facing the camera. Slow push in to medium close-up. Fade to black.

Style: Cinematic quality, desaturated color grading with warm undertones, 1940s Indonesian colonial atmosphere. Dramatic lighting with volumetric smoke effects.
Sound: Deep ominous bass drone, gunfire sounds at 0–3s, heavy impact boom at 4s, rapid whoosh sounds during the touch-and-vanish sequence, eerie silence at the end with wind ambience.

Extend the scene in this video1. At the end, the dark superhero character raises his hand and destroys all the Dutch soldiers into thick smoke.

variants.text:
以 image1 中的角色为主题（深色超级英雄，拥有发光的白眼、蜡染披风和烟雾光环）。场景设定在爪哇岛街道，敌人为荷兰殖民士兵。

0–3 秒：广角定场镜头，低角度仰拍天空。image1 中的超级英雄悬浮在半空中，黑色烟雾环绕其身，蜡染披风随风飘动。下方，荷兰士兵举枪瞄准并射击。枪口火光闪烁。子弹穿过超级英雄的身体，却毫无伤害，接触瞬间化作缕缕黑烟消散。摄像机缓慢推向悬浮的人物。

4–8 秒：超级英雄从天而降，重重地落在泥土路上，激起一圈黑烟冲击波。摄像机通过摇臂镜头向下倾斜跟拍。士兵们惊恐地向后踉跄，手忙脚乱地重新装弹。超级英雄站直身体，发光的双眼穿透烟雾。他以超自然的速度向士兵走去。

9–13 秒：快节奏序列——超级英雄以模糊的速度在士兵间穿梭。每当他用手触碰一名士兵，士兵便瞬间瓦解成黑烟并彻底消失。触碰即消失。摄像机在每次消除动作之间使用快速平移，追踪超级英雄的移动。三到四名士兵在短时间内接连消散。

13–15 秒：最终广角镜头——街道空无一人，只剩下士兵们曾经站立处残留的黑烟。超级英雄独自站在路中央，烟雾缭绕，发光的双眼注视着镜头。缓慢推向中景特写。淡出至黑色。

在 video1 中延展该场景。结尾处，这位深色超级英雄举起手，将所有荷兰士兵摧毁并化为浓烟。
